title: Structural Field Engineer
description:
Tatu City is seeking a technically proficient and detail-oriented Structural Field Engineer to join the Jabali Towers site team. This is a hands-on, site-based role focused on ensuring that all structural elements of the project are executed in precise accordance with the design specifications and the highest standards of quality and safety. The Structural Field Engineer will be responsible for the day-to-day inspection and supervision of structural works, providing critical technical support to the construction team for this complex high-rise project.

Key Responsibilities

On-Site Technical Supervision & Quality Assurance:

  • Serve as the primary on-site technical expert for all structural works, including deep foundations, reinforced concrete, post-tensioning systems, and structural steel erection.
  • Conduct rigorous daily inspections of all structural activities, including rebar placement, formwork installation, concrete pouring, and post-tensioning stressing, to ensure strict compliance with approved drawings and technical specifications.
  • Implement and enforce the project's Quality Assurance/Quality Control (QA/QC) program for all structural components, meticulously documenting all inspections, tests, and any non-conformance issues.
  • Review and provide technical approval for contractor submittals, including shop drawings, material certificates, concrete mix designs, and method statements.
  • Proactively identify potential structural issues on-site and work with the contractor and design teams to implement timely and effective solutions.

Coordination & Problem-Solving:

  • Interpret complex structural drawings and specifications to provide clear guidance to the contractor's site team.
  • Liaise directly with the design consultants to resolve technical queries (RFIs) and discrepancies discovered during construction.
  • Coordinate with other discipline field engineers (e.g., MEP, Architectural) to ensure that all structural embedment’s, block-outs, and penetrations are correctly located and installed.
  • Assist in maintaining accurate site records, including daily progress reports, inspection logs, and as-built information related to structural works.

Safety & Compliance:

  • Champion a culture of safety for all structural works, with a particular focus on formwork stability, working at height, and crane operations.
  • Ensure all construction activities are in full compliance with Kenyan building codes, local authority regulations, and international best practices (e.g., ACI, AISC).
  • Monitor contractor operations to ensure adherence to approved health and safety plans and procedures.

Requirements

Skills and Experience:

  • Education: A bachelor’s degree in civil or Structural Engineering from an internationally recognized university is essential.
  • Experience: A minimum of 8-12 years of direct, post-graduate experience as a site-based structural engineer on large-scale construction projects. A proven track record on high-rise buildings (20+ storeys) is mandatory.
  • Industry Background: Extensive hands-on experience working for major international main contractors or construction supervision consultants is critical. Experience on giga projects or with leading EPC firms like Bechtel is a significant advantage.
  • International Exposure: Demonstrable, hands-on international project experience in challenging construction environments is essential.
  • Technical Proficiency: Expert knowledge of structural engineering principles and modern construction methodologies for high-rise buildings.
  • Must be highly skilled in reading and interpreting complex structural drawings and specifications. Proficiency in using relevant software like AutoCAD and basic structural analysis tools is required.
  • Codes and Standards: Working knowledge of international design codes such as ACI 318, AISC, and ASCE 7 is required.

description:

About the Role

Join Williams-Sonoma this holiday season and help create an inspiring shopping experience for customers preparing to celebrate life's special moments at home. · Maintain organized stockrooms and sales floor presentation to ensure products are easy to shop.

· Support fulfillment activities, customer pickups, deliveries, and inventory accuracy as needed.

· Maintain a clean, safe, and organized sales floor, stockroom, and checkout area.

· Work collaboratively with teammates and support the store wherever business needs require.

· Follow all company policies, safety standards, and operational procedures.

· Enjoys helping customers and creating memorable shopping experiences.

· Thrives in a fast-paced retail environment.

· Works well independently and as part of a team.

· Is dependable, organized, and adaptable.

· Has strong communication and problem-solving skills.

· Can manage multiple priorities while maintaining attention to detail.

· Previous retail or customer service experience is preferred but not required.

Qualifications

· High school diploma or equivalent preferred.

· Ability to stand and move throughout the store for extended periods.

· Ability to operate a point-of-sale (POS) system.

· Ability to lift and move merchandise up to 75 pounds using appropriate equipment and safe lifting techniques.

· Flexible availability, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, based on business needs.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

· Opportunities to learn new skills and gain valuable retail experience

· The chance to be part of one of the most exciting seasons of the year

description:

  • Sign-on bonus available
  • Schedule: Monday thru Friday. No Nights or Weekends! WFH options available.

Why Clinicians Love The Treetop ABA

    Work alongside compassionate clinicians who genuinely enjoy collaborating, sharing ideas, and supporting one another's success.
  • BCBA-Led Clinical Excellence
    Our clinical culture is led by experienced BCBAs who understand the realities of the role and are committed to delivering exceptional, evidence-based care.

    Receive ongoing mentorship, guidance, and support from leaders who are invested in your professional growth and clinical success.

    We prioritize ethical decision-making, high-quality clinical outcomes, and doing what's right for our clients, not simply meeting productivity expectations.

    From free in-house CEUs to mentorship and professional development opportunities, we're committed to helping you grow throughout your career.

    With a 25-billable expectation, you'll have the time and support needed to provide high-quality, individualized care while maintaining a healthy work-life balance.

Who We Are

Are you ready to make a real difference while feeling genuinely supported? At The Treetop ABA, we're a close-knit, clinician-led team dedicated to delivering high-quality care-and helping you love what you do. Across NC you'll find a rewarding career opportunity that blends professional growth, flexibility, and balance.

Being a Board Certified Behavior Analyst (BCBA) is more than a profession-it's a purpose. That's why we've built a culture centered on compassion, collaboration, and continuous learning, giving you the tools and freedom to succeed while maintaining a healthy work-life balance.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Conduct Functional Behavior Assessments (FBAs) and create individualized treatment plans
  • Deliver play-based ABA therapy in the clinic and support families with home/community goals
  • Train, mentor, and supervise RBTs, ABATs, and Behavior Technicians
  • Collaborate with clinical peers to ensure quality, consistency, and excellent client outcomes
  • Collect and analyze data to measure progress and guide treatment decisions
  • Participate in team meetings, case reviews, and professional development

Requirements

What you'll need

  • North Carolina LBA (Licensed Behavior Analyst) required
  • Experience working with children with autism or developmental disabilities preferred
  • Strong interpersonal, organizational, and communication skills
  • A compassionate, team-oriented mindset

Benefits

  • 23 paid days off (15 days PTO plus 8 paid holidays)
  • Comprehensive benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision, STD and Life Insurance plans available
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Monthly Performance bonuses - with clear, attainable benchmarks
  • Professional Growth: $1,500 annual CEU stipend, free in-house CEUs, and ongoing mentorship and advancement opportunities as we expand throughout North Carolina.
  • Self-Care Perks: Enjoy lifestyle benefits like Walmart Plus, Uber Eats One, DashPass, and a gym membership stipend-because your well-being matters.
  • Referral Rewards: Earn bonuses when you help us grow our exceptional team.

Ready to Grow Your Career in North Carolina?

If you're looking for a company where you'll be supported as a clinician—not just measured by productivity—we'd love to meet you. Let's have a conversation about your career goals and see if Treetop ABA is the right fit for you.

The Treetop ABA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity, inclusion, and a workplace where everyone feels valued and supported.

title: 6am Inbound (Stocking) (T2822)
description:
The Starting Hourly Rate / Salario por Hora Inicial is $19.75 USD per hour. The Pay Range / Rango salarial is $19.75 USD - $29.65 USD per hour.

ALL ABOUT TARGET

Working at Target means helping all families discover the joy of everyday life. We bring that vision to life through our values and culture. Learn more about Target here.

ALL ABOUT GENERAL MERCHANDISE

Experts of operations, process and efficiency who enable a consistent experience for our guests by ensuring product is set, in-stock, accurately priced and signed on the sales floor. The General Merchandise and Food Sales team leads inbound, outbound, replenishment, inventory accuracy, presentation, pricing and promotional signing processes for all General Merchandise (GM) areas of the store. This team leads Food & Beverage and Food Service, providing a fresh and food safe experience. Experts enable efficient delivery to our guests by owning pick, pack and ship fulfillment work.

At Target, we believe in our team members having meaningful experiences that help them build and develop skills for a career. The role of an Inbound Expert can provide you with the:

  • Knowledge of guest service fundamentals and experience supporting a guest first culture across the store

  • Experience in retail business fundamentals including: department sales trends, inventory management, and process efficiency and improvement

  • Experience executing daily/weekly workload to support business priorities and deliver on sales goals

As an Inbound Expert, no two days are ever the same, but a typical day will most likely include the following responsibilities:

  • Execute a detailed, accurate and efficient sorting operation.

  • Stock, organize and store reserve product and straighten merchandise on sales floor.

  • Maintain product availability on the salesfloor for GM categories.

  • Operate powered equipment as necessary while unloading freight or moving merchandise.

  • Process defective merchandise and handle environmentally sensitive (ESIM) items in compliance with applicable laws and regulations.

  • Demonstrate a culture of ethical conduct, safety and compliance.

  • Work in a safe manner at all times; comply with all safety policies, best practices, and training; report hazards and correct where possible.

  • Support guest services such as back-up cashier, order pick up (OPU) and Drive up (DU) and maintain a compliance culture while executing those duties, such as compliance with federal, state, and local adult beverage laws.

  • Create a welcoming experience by greeting guests as you are completing your daily tasks.

  • When guests need assistance, engage with guests in a welcoming way, to help solve their specific needs.

  • Thank guests and let them know we’re happy they chose to shop at Target.

  • All other duties based on business needs

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

This may be the right job for you if:

  • You enjoy interacting and helping others - including guests that shop our store and fellow team members you work with.

  • You thrive in a fast-moving, highly active and physically demanding role, where teamwork, flexibility, and creative problem solving are key to success.

  • You are open to working a flexible work schedule with varying hours, days or shifts (including nights, weekends, holidays and other peak shopping times).

The good news is that we have some amazing training that will help teach you everything you need to know to be an Inbound Expert. But, there are a few skills you should have from the get-go:

  • Must be at least 18 years of age or older

  • Welcoming and helpful attitude toward all guests and other team members

  • Ability to communicate on multiple frequency devices and operate handheld scanners, and other technology equipment as directed

  • Work both independently and with a team

  • Resolve guest questions quickly on the spot

  • Attention to detail and follow a multi-step processes

  • Capability to remain focused and composed in a fast-paced environment and accomplish multiple tasks within established timeframes

We are an awesome place to work and care about our teams, so we want to make sure we are clear on a few more basics that we expect:

  • Accurately handle cash register operations as needed

  • Climb up and down ladders

  • Scan, handle and move merchandise efficiently and safely, including frequently lifting or moving merchandise up to 44 pounds

  • Flexible work schedule (e.g., nights, weekends and holidays) reliable and prompt attendance necessary

  • Capable of working in and exposure to varying temperatures, humidity, and other elements while performing certain job duties including but not limited to Drive-Up, carryout, etc.

  • Ability to remain mobile for the duration of a scheduled shift (shift length may vary)

title: Lead Engineer - EDGE Controls
description:
Job Description Summary

Lead Engineer SCADA & EDGE is a cross-functional engineering discipline centered on an approach, mindset, and process. All activities that consider both the business and the technical needs of the customers with the goal of providing a quality product that meets the users needs.

The discipline that executes a robust process of design, creation, and optimization of systems, consisting of identification and quantification of system requirements, creation of alternate system design concepts, performance of design trade studies, selection and implementation of the best designs and verification that the design is properly integrated and executed. Process that proceeds from concept to production to operation.

Impacts departmental operations and responsible for planning/execution. The role has some autonomy but is focused on execution of activities within an operating discipline covered by standard functional practices and procedures. Some judgment may be required but this is typically with guidance.

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Perform requirements engineering for new farm level closed loop EDGE applications and analytics, including quantification and documentation of requirements and design tradeoffs for wind turbine / wind-farm level applications using Industrial and GEV standard protocols. The goal is to develop scalable, reliable and robust farm level applications for SCADA & EDGE software platforms working together with Design and Development teams considering system level impact and lifecycle aspects that meet customers’ requirements and quality standards.

  • Design EDGE application software platform features and applications with analytics / optimization algorithm in C#, .NET, and Python code, as well as consolidate test case for functional and system level testing.

  • Verify & validate implementation of new apps/algorithms/software features and applications by executing test cases either via simulation or remote testing on actual customer turbines.

    Deploy and follow established process to containerize algorithm as an app and deploy in an actual wind farm in the Renewables EDGE / Other industry standard EDGE OS environment and verify the algorithm performance.

  • Execute routine analyses using vested methods and technologies and/or contributes to technological developments in teams under supervision.

  • Contribute to product configuration management, sustaining and customer support. Support product development program, design review discussions and present relevant design details to chief engineers for evaluation and approval.

  • Collaborate with other Engineering and Global Research Center teams on new energy system control technology and lead design implementation efforts. The applicant may be called to travel up to 10% of the time to support product validation, product and customer discussions.

Required Qualifications

  • Master / Bachelor's degree in Controls/ Computer Science Engineering with Renewable Energy Emphasis preferred.
  • Experience in software development (C#, .NET, Python) testing, validation, and deployment.

  • Experience of working with dockers and Kubernetes environment

  • Experience relevant to wind turbine systems, Industrial SCADA & EDGE systems and Control system design

  • Experience with MATLAB Simulink, C/C++/C#, Python, GEV Renewables SCADA & EDGE Software Platforms

  • Experience in system and software design principles, SDLC, Agile methodology and AI based software and tools

  • Hands on experience in implementing cyber security and coding standards.

  • Demonstrated success in a global team environment, effective communication skills and self-starter, who delivers results with minimal supervision

Desired Characteristics

  • Strong oral and written communication skills. Ability to document, plan, market, and execute programs.

Additional Information

Relocation Assistance Provided: Yes

title: Scientist, Operations Labs, Technical Consumer Data Research
description:
Job Description Summary:

The Scientist role in Technical Consumer Data Research (TCDR) reports to the APAC Senior Director, TCDR, and is primarily a lab-based position responsible for leading internal sensory operations and supporting business-critical projects across the GCM and ASP Operating Unit. The role plays a key part in delivering high-quality sensory and consumer data to enable product, packaging, and equipment development aligned with productivity, renovation, and innovation priorities.

As an individual contributor, the TCDR Scientist designs, manages, and executes sensory and consumer research within internal sensory lab environments, ensuring rigorous study preparation, execution, and analysis. The role supports cross-functional business projects by generating reliable data, actionable insights, and clear recommendations tailored to Operating Unit needs.

Working closely with the broader TCDR team and business partners, the Scientist contributes to local innovation initiatives by applying human-centric design principles and integrating consumer understanding into development processes. This includes building product and category knowledge, uncovering consumer preferences, and translating insights into guidance that strengthens the innovation pipeline and ensures market-relevant, consumer-preferred solutions.

Organizationally, TCDR sits within the Innovation, Technology & Strategy function, enabling strong integration of sensory and consumer insights into strategic decision-making and reinforcing the role’s impact on delivering competitive, market-leading offerings.

Functional Related Activities / Key Responsibilities

  • Manage and lead all internal Sensory laboratory operations to include laboratory, and personnel such as panels, contractors, technicians, interns, as appropriate.

  • Maintain laboratory to highest standard and lead required annual audits successfully.

  • Conduct and manage laboratory-based experiments, ensuring accurate data collection, adherence to protocols, and timely delivery of high-quality results to support research and business objectives for the OU requirements.

  • Design, execute and conduct sensory & consumer research studies to meet specific project objectives gaining valuable sensory insights and providing guidance to the development team and Business partner. Manage all phases of the study including experimental design, test execution, statistical analyses and reporting of the results, aligned with OU TCDR leader.

  • Provide recommendations on business solutions based on strong technical consumer research.

  • Conduct competitor benchmarking and Product/Packaging/Equipment evaluation to understand the competitive landscape in support of OU categories and brands.

  • Understand and define fundamental consumer/sensory requirements of your categories and inject the knowledge into solution development.

  • Be curious, proactively leverage external knowledge (supplier, symposium, literature review) to identify & prove alternative beneficial future forward methods (AI assisted), aligned with TCDR global category leader.

  • Work as a close partner with the R&D categories team, Marketing and Human Insight team.

  • Work with minimal guidance and in close collaboration with project leaders.

Data Analytics & Synthesis

  • Perform analysis and interpret test results; form conclusions on studies conducted. Prepare and present technical conclusion.

  • Knowledge and intermediate level usage of Statistical software (SPSS, SAS, JMP, etc.), Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel, Project, Word.

  • Harness evolving technologies and data analytics to develop tools and solutions that bolster competitive advantage and deliver market-leading results.

  • Bring the outside in, remain current with relevant scientific literature from external resources.

Technical Risk Management

  • Skilled in identifying and assessing technical risks, mitigate risks, and implementing proactive measures to ensure project continuity and system integrity.

Business Understanding & System Knowledge

  • System Thinking, ability to listen to and influence those in less technical roles to act and invest in capabilities with compelling business cases.

Technical Communication & Data Storytelling

  • Translate strategic visions into actionable plans, using knowledge of current business processes and best practices.

  • Prepare and present technical conclusions to technical and non-technical audiences.

Influencing & Stakeholder Management

  • Function as a key business partner by effectively managing and nurturing internal and external relationships, including collaboration with research suppliers, academic institutions, and cross-functional project teams, to support research initiatives.

  • Educational Requirement: Batchelor Science Degree BSc or MSc/ PhD from an accredited University in Food or Sensory Science, Engineering, Behavioral Psychology, or related field, and technical mastery of Sensory, Consumer, Applied Statistics, to include science, methodologies, frameworks, and approaches.

Operational Sensory laboratory experience in preferred.

title: Database Engineer
description:
TechFlow is seeking an experienced Database Engineer / Oracle Database Administrator (DBA) to support a mission-critical DoD software development and modernization program in Montgomery, AL. This program provides software development and technical support services to sustain, enhance, and optimize a critical customer system through secure, scalable, and maintainable software solutions.

The Database Engineer/DBA will be responsible for the administration, security, performance, and lifecycle management of enterprise Oracle databases supporting mission-critical applications. This role will ensure database environments remain secure, highly available, and optimized while supporting Agile software development and DevSecOps practices. The successful candidate will work closely with software engineers, DevSecOps engineers, system architects, testers, and program leadership to support database modernization initiatives and maintain the integrity, availability, and performance of critical data assets.

Key Responsibilities

  • Install, configure, administer, patch, upgrade, and manage the lifecycle of Oracle database environments.
  • Monitor database performance, availability, and health, proactively identifying and resolving performance bottlenecks and operational issues.
  • Optimize database performance through tuning, indexing strategies, query optimization, and capacity planning.
  • Implement and maintain database security controls, including user access management, encryption, auditing, and compliance with DoD cybersecurity requirements.
  • Develop, maintain, and regularly validate comprehensive backup, recovery, and disaster recovery procedures to meet Government Recovery Point Objective (RPO) and Recovery Time Objective (RTO) requirements.
  • Design, implement, and maintain database schema changes using version-controlled migration scripts integrated with CI/CD pipelines.
  • Ensure database deployment scripts are automated, repeatable, defect-free, and environment agnostic.
  • Maintain configuration management documentation and version control for all database configurations and settings.
  • Support end-to-end traceability of database requirements through implementation, testing, and documentation.
  • Collaborate with software development teams to design efficient database structures and support application modernization initiatives.
  • Support ETL processes, data integration activities, and maintenance of database metadata and data dictionary documentation.
  • Participate in troubleshooting production issues and implementing continuous improvements to database operations.
  • Ensure compliance with organizational standards for security, quality, documentation, and configuration management.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree (or equivalent experience) in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of Oracle Database Administration experience supporting enterprise environments.
  • Active DoD 8140/8570 IAT Level II baseline certification (e.g., CompTIA Security+ or equivalent).
  • Extensive experience installing, configuring, patching, upgrading, and administering Oracle databases.
  • Experience developing and managing version-controlled database migration scripts integrated with CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong knowledge of Oracle database performance tuning, optimization, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
  • Experience implementing database security hardening, encryption, auditing, and Security Technical Implementation Guide (STIG) compliance.
  • Experience designing, implementing, testing, and maintaining enterprise backup and recovery strategies.
  • Experience supporting Oracle databases hosted in cloud environments, including AWS.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with AWS database services and cloud-native database architectures.
  • Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automated database deployments.
  • Experience supporting high-availability and disaster recovery database architectures.
  • Knowledge of Git, GitLab CI/CD, and automated deployment pipelines.
  • Experience with database monitoring and performance management tools.
  • Familiarity with RMF accreditation processes and DoD cybersecurity policies.

title: Research Engineer
description:
Location: Remote (United States)

Industry: AI training data infrastructure

Compensation: $140K-$250K base, plus equity

About the Company

Our partner is a YC-backed company building a new kind of marketplace in the AI training data space. Rather than operating as a labor marketplace, they provide infrastructure that lets data producers transform their existing data into formats AI labs want and sell it directly to those labs. This democratized model unlocks far more high-value data sources, and the team is growing quickly to keep up with demand.

The Opportunity

This is the company's top hiring priority and a genuinely hard research problem. Because data flows through a decentralized marketplace, ensuring quality at scale is the single biggest bottleneck to growth. As a Research Engineer, you will build the automated systems that verify and assure data quality so that suppliers consistently deliver excellent data to buyers.

You will start by digging into the data manually to understand failure modes, then design systems to automate quality checks at scale, combining rule-based approaches with AI for fuzzier cases and human-in-the-loop review where it makes sense. This is fundamentally a research role focused on building automated systems, not manual QA.

Responsibilities

  • Identify data quality issues including inconsistencies, formatting problems, and ingestion challenges
  • Perform initial manual data quality review to deeply understand failure modes
  • Build systems to automate quality checks at scale using rule-based and AI-driven approaches
  • Design hybrid systems that balance automation with human-in-the-loop review where appropriate
  • Continuously improve verification methods as the data landscape and AI tooling evolve

Requirements

  • Deeply technical, with a strong learning slope and the ability to ramp quickly in a fast-moving field
  • Background in AI/ML engineering, or software engineering at an AI-focused company with visible data ingestion and processing experience
  • Ability to reason about likely data quality problems from first principles
  • Comfortable owning ambiguous, open-ended problems end to end
  • Comfortable working in person, full-time, in a San Francisco office
  • Bonus: experience working with noisy or unstructured data, or judgment on when to use automation versus human-in-the-loop review

title: Electrical Technician
description:
Job Description

Overview

Electrical Engineer responsible for reviewing technical specifications, schematics, and automation documents, preparing protection diagrams, validating transformer applications, and ensuring system integration. The role also involves vendor/tender evaluation, client collaboration, factory acceptance testing, and supporting sales/margin optimization through engineering efficiency.

Your role

  • Specification Study: Conduct detailed studies of project specifications to ensure alignment with client requirements and technical standards.
  • Control & Protection Schematic Review: Review control and protection schematic drawings from partner units to ensure accuracy and functionality.
  • SAS Document Review: Analyze System Automation Schematics (SAS) documents, including Functional Design Specifications, SAS Architecture, GTP, and BOQ.
  • Substation Equipment Review: Evaluate primary and secondary substation switchgear/equipment schematics, focusing on coordination with protection schematics.
  • Protection SLD Preparation: Prepare Single Line Diagrams (SLD) for protection systems, ensuring compliance with client specifications.
  • CT/CVT/PT Application Checks: Perform application checks and calculations for Current Transformers (CT), Capacitor Voltage Transformers (CVT), and Potential Transformers (PT) with respect to protective relays and protection functions.
  • Cable Philosophy & Interconnection Schedules: Develop and review cable philosophies and interconnection schedules to ensure system integration.
  • Tender & Vendor Review: Review tender/vendor offers related to Control & Relay (C&R) panels to ensure technical compatibility and cost-efficiency.
  • Client Interaction: Collaborate with clients for the approval of engineering drawings and documents.
  • Sales & Margin Optimization: Achieve sales targets and improve gross margins through effective engineering optimization.
  • Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT): Conduct Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) for electrical equipment such as transformers, current transformers, and voltage transformers to ensure product quality and performance.

About you

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in electrical engineering, particularly in protection systems and substation design.

title: Software Engineer - Robotics Simulation
description:
We are seeking a Robotics Simulation Software Engineer to design and develop advanced simulation platforms used to evaluate, validate, and verify the performance of robotics applications across a variety of operational scenarios and test cases. This role will focus on building scalable, high-fidelity simulation environments that enable the testing of Autonomous Guided Vehicles (AGVs), Fleet Management Systems and web-based controllers before deployment in production environments.

You will play a key role in building a virtual validation framework that accelerates product development, reduces dependence on physical hardware, and improves system reliability.

Key Responsibilities

Simulation Environment Development

  • Design, develop, and maintain simulation tools and frameworks for validating robotics applications under a wide range of operating conditions and test scenarios.
  • Build high-fidelity virtual environments that accurately represent warehouse, manufacturing, and intralogistics operations.
  • Develop scalable simulation architectures capable of supporting large fleets of autonomous mobile robots.

System Validation & Verification

  • Enable early-stage validation of Fleet Management Systems and robotics software without requiring physical robots.
  • Develop automated test scenarios, evaluation metrics, and performance benchmarks.
  • Analyze discrepancies between simulated and real-world system behavior and continuously improve simulation accuracy.
  • Support regression testing and verification of software releases using simulation-based testing methodologies.

Virtual Lab & Test Automation

  • Integrate simulation tools into CI/CD pipelines to support automated testing and continuous validation.
  • Collaborate with software developers, QA engineers, systems engineers, and robotics teams to define test requirements and acceptance criteria.

Software Engineering & Quality

Support troubleshooting and root-cause analysis of software and system-level issues identified through simulation.

Tasks and Qualifications:

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Robotics, Computer Science, Mechatronics, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • 3+ years of professional software development experience using C++ and/or Python.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Linux-based development environments.
  • Experience developing software for robotics, autonomous systems, or industrial automation solutions.
  • Strong hands-on experience with robotics simulation and development tools, including:
    • ROS2
    • Gazebo
    • Isaac Sim
    • Python
  • Experience with modern software engineering practices including:
    • Git version control
    • Agile development methodologies
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Experience with software quality assurance practices, including code reviews, unit testing, integration testing, and system testing

title: Orientation and Mobility Specialist
description:
About Us

TheraPeds Partners is a therapist-owned and operated organization. We partner with schools to provide Orientation and Mobility specialists (O&M) services to PreK–12 students nationwide. As a team of special education providers, we understand the education process, IDEA requirements, and the importance of collaboration within multidisciplinary teams. Our mission is to deliver high-quality O&M (SPED) services while making meaningful connections in a collaborative learning environment.

Job Description and Responsibilities

This is a part-time, on-site role as a Orientation Mobility Specialist serving a school located in Republic, MO.

The Orientation and Mobility Specialist (O&M) will be responsible for providing direct services to students, conducting assessments, developing IEP plans, evaluating progress, and collaborating with interdisciplinary teams (therapists, educators, parents). The role requires strong communication and interpersonal skills, as well as a passion for working with students with special needs.

Job Details

  • Part-time 10 hours/week
  • 2026-2027 School year, August - May/June.
  • On-site, in-person
  • PreK – 12 grades
  • Approximately 7 students
  • Dual support from the District and TheraPeds

  • Guaranteed hours, including documentation, administrative and planning time
  • $60.00– $80.00+/hour ($600 - $800/week)

Responsibilities

  • Develop, implement, and assess individualized education plans (IEPs) for students with disabilities.
  • Deliver instruction tailored to meet the diverse learning styles and needs of students.
  • Collaborate with parents, educators, and specialists to ensure a comprehensive approach to student learning and support.

  • Recommend environmental modifications
  • Help plan safe travel routes around the school
  • Monitor student progress and adapt instructional strategies to improve outcomes.
  • Provide one-on-one or small group instruction
  • Tailor lessons based on the student’s vision level, age, and mobility needs
  • Adjust strategies for students with additional disabilities
  • Maintain accurate records of student performance, behavior, and progress to inform ongoing instruction and planning.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree required; graduate degree in Orientation & Mobility, Vision Studies, or related field preferred

Physical Requirements

Working and playing with students requires that employees must be able to perform the necessary physical movement functions, as needed, such as lifting, sitting, walking, standing, crawling, and engaging with students in all physical locations and activities, while adhering to the duties outlined by the district.

TheraPeds Partners is seeking a part-time, on-site Orientation and Mobility Specialist (O&M) for a school-based position in Republic, MO. title: SS&P - Supplier Lead Auditor - Linkou
description:
Introduction to the job

ASML supports the semiconductor industry’s ongoing quest for producing faster, smarter and more energy efficient chips. We are a young, dynamic, international and highly skilled workforce. ASML creates the systems that the semiconductor industry needs to achieve its goals. This can only be accomplished with a strong support of our suppliers.

Do you have a passion to improve the Quality of ASML’s products and processes?

Are you experienced in Quality Assurance to drive the improvement of products, services and processes in a high-tech environment?

If you are looking for a next challenge in your career – Join ASML Supplier Audits, a team of Supplier Audit professional

Role and responsibilities

The Supplier Audit team identifies risks and drives continuous improvement in key processes at suppliers related to Quality, Logistics, Technology, Cost reduction and Sustainability (QLTCS) performance.

As Supplier Lead Auditor you act as an independent expert to identify risks, verify risk mitigations and drive quality improvements at suppliers and in the ASML supply chain.

The Supplier Lead Auditor plans, executes, and leads cross-sector audits versus defined ASML requirements and standards. He/she supports the Category Management and Supplier Account Teams in driving effective resolution of key quality, logistics, or technology issues in the supply chain by executing theme audits at suppliers. Because of risk based supplier audits, QLTC risks are identified before supplier selection via focused selection audits.

Together with the category management the supplier strategy is translated in an agreed audit plan. This includes the alignment with the worldwide audit strategy. To drive impact, audits are managed end-2-end, from planning, to execution and follow-up. Regular status updates are provided to the cluster, categories and other stakeholders. Finally the verification of the improvements is done in collaboration with the supplier account teams.

Next, the Global Quality lead auditor team owns the audit process and the Supplier Lead Auditor supports the audit process by identifying best audit practices for the Global Supplier audit team.

Education and experience

Master or Bachelor degree in Engineering, Science or Management Sciences.

Seniority and broad experience in: supplier management, manufacturing, logistics, development & engineering.
> 5 years working experience preferably at ASML or other high-tech companies, working with complex products and processes
Auditing experience, preferably in semiconductor industry
Broad experience with different technologies (e.g. mechatronics, optical etc.)
Experience with new product introductions at suppliers

Skills

Working at the cutting edge of tech, you’ll always have new challenges and new problems to solve – and working together is the only way to do that. You won’t work in a silo. Instead, you’ll be part of a creative, dynamic work environment where you’ll collaborate with supportive colleagues. There is always space for creative and unique points of view. You’ll have the flexibility and trust to choose how best to tackle tasks and solve problems.
To thrive in this job, you’ll need the following skills:

Certified ISO9001 Lead Auditor or equivalent
Good knowledge of International Quality Standards e.g. ISO9001, ISO14001
Broad expertise of Quality tools: QFD, FMEA, Design Reviews, Design for Reliability, Ishikawa, 5 Why analysis, 8D, MSA, SPC, statistical methods, value stream analysis, Kaizen events, brainstorming sessions
Expertise in risk management
Experienced in project management
Broad manufacturing knowledge: World-class operations, Flow-production, Lean Manufacturing, Cleanroom standards and procedures, 5S etc.

Strong personality with natural authority towards supplier and audit team
Independent, objective personality acting with integrity
Organizational knowledge and business sense (good feeling where “win – win” can be obtained for ASML and suppliers)
Strong communication skills
Strong analytical skills to identify key issues and associated risks as well as their root causes
Strong networker with good negotiation and team building skills

Other information

The Supplier Lead Auditor
Reports to Manager - Supplier Collaboration (Audit, Quality & Logistics)
Functions as part of the ASML Global Quality audit team
Interfaces with internal stakeholders at ASML & external key suppliers
Contributes to the continuous improvement of the Supplier Audit framework of ASML

The position requires frequent travelling up to ~50%

title: Intern, Corporate Land
description:
Welcome to ConocoPhillips, where innovation and excellence create a platform for opportunity and growth. Come realize your full potential here.

Who We Are

We are one of the world’s largest independent exploration and production companies, based on proved reserves and production of liquids and natural gas. With operations and activities in 13 countries, we explore for, develop, and produce crude oil and natural gas globally. We are challenged with an important job to safely find and deliver energy to the world. Our employees are critical to our success, and with them we power civilization.

We’re grounded by our SPIRIT Values – safety, people, integrity, responsibility, innovation, and teamwork. These values position us to deliver strong performance in a dynamic business – but not at all costs. We believe it’s not just what we do – it’s how we do it – that sets us apart.

Fostering an Inclusive Work Environment

To deliver superior performance, we create an environment that respects the contributions and differences of every individual. Wherever possible, we use these differences to drive competitive business advantage, personal growth and, ultimately, create business success.

Job Summary

Corporate Land Overview

Corporate Land is an exciting, functionally unique group. We are comprised of two primary asset regions: Permian Business Unit and the Gulf Coast & Rockies Business Unit. Each asset is unique and provides opportunity for growth in skills and experience. Whether working in Division Order or Land Administration, your daily activities can vary depending on projects, time sensitive deadlines, and additional responsibilities that may arise. This gives way to an interesting and challenging environment pushing individuals to excel in their performance.

Corporate Land is a leveraged, multi-functional organization responsible for establishing, maintaining, and protecting the legal ownership of real property assets for ConocoPhillips. We provide distinct value to the company through analyzing legal documents such as oil and gas leases, contracts, title opinions, and conveyance documents to establish and maintain joint venture and revenue ownership. We also field owner inquiries regarding lease interpretations, ownership interest calculations, payments, and transfer of ownership. Additionally, we maintain lease acquisition cost, and create visual representation through use of spatial data for both surface and mineral ownership to facilitate business decisions.

Position Summary

As a Corporate Land intern, you will be exposed to lease, contract, and division order ownership analysis, computerized mapping, and data integrity/analysis projects in ConocoPhillips land systems - the same exciting assignments as our full-time hires. Corporate Land interns will participate in site wide internship activities such as field trips, seminars, social activities, and opportunities to meet senior management. Your supervisor and your mentor will provide mentorship and guidance throughout your internship as well as periodic performance evaluations.

Your internship will culminate with a presentation crafted to showcase your knowledge of your work assignments and other elements of your internship experience.

Assignments will be at our site located in Bartlesville, Oklahoma. Typical length of our internships varies from 10 to 12 weeks based on the project and your availability.

Position Overview

Responsibilities may include:

  • Analyzing and interpreting oil and gas leases and contracts to resolve legal ownership, acreage figures, payment amounts and obligation dates
  • Analyzing and interpreting legal ownership through the examination of oil and gas leases, contracts, division order title opinions, and other title documents to be used in calculating the decimal of ownership attributable to production
  • Maintaining legal ownership pursuant to analysis and interpretation of necessary legal documentation (conveyances, probate, court orders, etc.) in accordance with respective state laws and regulations
  • Interpreting marketing arrangements to determine who will be remitting to ConocoPhillips and to whom ConocoPhillips will disburse
  • Establishing and maintaining cost ownership and Council of Petroleum Accountants Society (COPAS) data in the system to assure proper partner billing
  • Ensuring efficient termination activities for producing areas when ConocoPhillips’ involvement ceases
  • Ensuring the timely facilitation of relinquishments of oil and gas leases to avoid penalties, financial misstatements and unnecessary payments
  • Developing a positive rapport with internal and external customers

Basic/Required:

  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis for anyone other than current employer and/or education institution
  • Pursuing a Bachelor's degree or higher in Business, Accounting, Finance, Energy Management, Agricultural Economics, Economics, other related field, or foreign equivalent
  • Current level in college: Freshman through Senior
  • Expected graduation date: Fall 2027 through Spring/Fall 2030
  • Available for internship starting mid-late May 2027
  • A minimum of ten (10) continuous weeks availability for internship

Preferred:

  • A minimum cumulative and major GPA of 3.0 on a 4.0 scale
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office products
  • Delivers results through realistic planning to accomplish goals
  • Builds effective solutions based on available information and makes timely decisions that are safe and ethical
  • Drives thoughtful and pragmatic change, encourages innovative thinking and continuous improvement, and models adaptability through resourcefulness, flexibility and positivity
  • Builds positive relationships based on trust and seeks collaboration across organizational boundaries to achieve goals

All interested candidates must complete an online application at the ConocoPhillips Careers website to be considered for an interview. title: Orientation and Mobility Specialist
description:
About Us

TheraPeds Partners is a therapist-owned and operated organization. We partner with schools to provide Orientation and Mobility specialists (O&M) services to PreK–12 students nationwide. As a team of special education providers, we understand the education process, IDEA requirements, and the importance of collaboration within multidisciplinary teams. Our mission is to deliver high-quality O&M (SPED) services while making meaningful connections in a collaborative learning environment.

Job Description and Responsibilities

This is a part-time, on-site role as a Orientation Mobility Specialist serving a school located in Spartanburg, SC.

The Orientation and Mobility Specialist (O&M) will be responsible for providing direct services to students, conducting assessments, developing IEP plans, evaluating progress, and collaborating with interdisciplinary teams (therapists, educators, parents). The role requires strong communication and interpersonal skills, as well as a passion for working with students with special needs.

Job Details

  • Part-time 20 hours/week
  • 2026-2027 School year, August - May/June.
  • On-site, in-person
  • PreK – 12 grades
  • Dual support from the District and TheraPeds
  • Competitive pay
  • Job duties: educational services, case management, evaluations
  • Guaranteed hours, including documentation, administrative and planning time
  • $65.00– $85.00+/hour ($1300 - $1700/week)

Responsibilities

  • Develop, implement, and assess individualized education plans (IEPs) for students with disabilities.
  • Deliver instruction tailored to meet the diverse learning styles and needs of students.
  • Collaborate with parents, educators, and specialists to ensure a comprehensive approach to student learning and support.
  • Assess school campuses for travel safety
  • Recommend environmental modifications
  • Help plan safe travel routes around the school
  • Monitor student progress and adapt instructional strategies to improve outcomes.
  • Provide one-on-one or small group instruction
  • Tailor lessons based on the student’s vision level, age, and mobility needs
  • Adjust strategies for students with additional disabilities
  • Maintain accurate records of student performance, behavior, and progress to inform ongoing instruction and planning.
  • Create a welcoming, safe, and productive classroom environment that encourages positive behavior and learning.
  • Provide guidance and support to classroom staff in implementing educational strategies for students with special needs.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree required; graduate degree in Orientation & Mobility, Vision Studies, or related field preferred
  • COMS Certification (ACVREP) required or preferred
  • 1+ years of experience in a school setting preferred
  • Experience working with children with visual impairments
  • Knowledge of orientation and mobility assessments and instruction
  • Organizational and time management skills
  • Proficient in use of technology
  • Fingerprint background clearance
  • Ability to collaborate with school staff and parents with a demonstrated ability to exercise a high level of tact and discretion in both internal and external communications

Physical Requirements

Working and playing with students requires that employees must be able to perform the necessary physical movement functions, as needed, such as lifting, sitting, walking, standing, crawling, and engaging with students in all physical locations and activities, while adhering to the duties outlined by the district.

Benefits

Benefits (eligibility dependent on employment status)

  • Competitive compensation package with benefits including health, dental, and vision and 401K (W2)
  • Resources for health benefit enrollment and hourly rates which includes a stipend for health benefits and taxes (1099)
  • Opportunities for professional development and continuing education
  • Access to a supportive network within the TheraPeds community
  • Guaranteed Hours
  • Bi-Monthly Salary Deposits
  • This position will be a W-2 employee or a 1099 contractor

Summary

TheraPeds Partners is seeking a part-time, on-site Orientation and Mobility Specialist (O&M) for a school-based position in Spartanburg, SC. This role is ideal for candidates searching for orientation and mobility specialist jobs near me, Orientation and mobility jobs, South Carolina orientation and mobility positions, or part-time orientation and mobility roles.

description:

The Commercial Leader, part of GE Vernova’s Onshore Wind International (ONWI) team is responsible for leading cross-functional deal teams to develop competitive and compliant commercial offers as a precursor to negotiating and closing contracts for the supply, installation and service of GEV’s wind turbines. This role owns the end-to-end commercial process, including shaping contractual positions, negotiating agreements, and securing successful contract awards in line with GE policies and risk frameworks. Working closely with Sales, Technical, Legal, Risk, Finance, Tax, and Project Management, the Commercial Leader ensures alignment across all stakeholders while driving a clear winning strategy.

At a senior level, the role requires the ability to manage complex, large-scale deals, anticipate and mitigate risks, influence senior leadership, and mentor junior team members, all while upholding the highest standards of integrity and compliance.

Job Description

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Act as Commercial Leader for ONWI, supporting the Commercial team and reporting to the Regional Commercial Director.

  • Drive achievement of team KPIs, with a focus on orders, cash collection, and margin performance

  • Lead the development and execution of the overall commercial strategy for each deal.

  • Prepare, structure, and negotiate commercial offers, including terms and conditions and internal costing, while supporting the technical solution.

  • Optimise deal value based on market conditions and competitive positioning.

  • Mobilise and coordinate cross-functional teams (Legal, Commercial Finance, Risk, Engineering) to develop integrated commercial and technical proposals.

  • Assess and present deal risk profiles, obtaining required internal approvals to proceed.

  • Lead customer engagement on proposals, including drafting and negotiating commercial and technical terms.

  • Ensure timely delivery of bids, managing cross-functional inputs to meet deadlines and customer expectations.

  • Support delivery of commercial team metrics related to orders and margin outcomes.

  • Provide leadership, coaching, and mentorship to junior commercial team members and broader stakeholders with regards to Commercial Proposals.

  • Drive continuous improvement in proposal development, enhancing quality, efficiency, and effectiveness across the regional and ONWI Commercial teams.

  • Contribute toward strategy and offering to report the market demand and support Product Line to define the product and features creating value for the customers.

  • Lead complex deal structures, including turnkey solutions, managing partner onboarding, qualification, and commercial risk-sharing strategy (e.g. consortium agreements).

  • Independently review, mark up, and negotiate contracts, ensuring alignment with GE’s risk status and commercial standards.

Qualifications and Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent, from an accredited college or university.

  • 10+ years of relevant commercial, sales, or contract negotiation experience

  • Demonstrated leadership capability, including experience working with virtual project teams.

  • Strong interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills, with a collaborative working style.

  • Confident presenting to executive stakeholders and customers.

  • Comfortable engaging and influencing stakeholders at all levels of the organisation.

  • Proven skills in process analysis, problem solving, and strategic thinking.

  • Customer-focused mindset with strong commercial awareness.

  • Willingness and flexibility to travel and work intensively during key negotiation periods.

  • Fluent in English, both written and spoken.

Desired Characteristics:

  • Background in sales, contracts, or customer-facing roles within the renewable energy sector

  • Experience negotiating high-value, complex contracts.

  • Knowledge of wind turbine technology and project execution.

  • Experience in tendering, sales, or roles requiring extensive customer interaction.

  • Demonstrated leadership, mentoring, and coaching capabilities, including across virtual teams.

  • Strong public speaking and presentation skills.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a proactive, solutions-oriented approach.

description:
Welcome to ConocoPhillips, where innovation and excellence create a platform for opportunity and growth. Come realize your full potential here.

Who We Are

We are one of the world’s largest independent exploration and production companies, based on proved reserves and production of liquids and natural gas. With operations and activities in 13 countries, we explore for, develop, and produce crude oil and natural gas globally. We are challenged with an important job to safely find and deliver energy to the world. Our employees are critical to our success, and with them we power civilization.

We’re grounded by our SPIRIT Values – safety, people, integrity, responsibility, innovation, and teamwork. These values position us to deliver strong performance in a dynamic business – but not at all costs. We believe it’s not just what we do – it’s how we do it – that sets us apart.

Fostering an Inclusive Work Environment

To deliver superior performance, we create an environment that respects the contributions and differences of every individual. Wherever possible, we use these differences to drive competitive business advantage, personal growth and, ultimately, create business success.

Job Summary

Supply Chain Overview

Working in partnership with operations management, our supply chain team works to create maximum value for the company. It’s our job to procure and handle the goods and services that enable ConocoPhillips to deliver on complex projects across the globe.

Everyone on the supply chain team plays a critical role in helping ConocoPhillips to succeed by providing global, commercial, and proactive procurement expertise. Not only do we strive for the effective management of our cost structure, we focus on sourcing strategies that support the company’s commitment to safety and environmental and social responsibility.

ConocoPhillips provides opportunities in Supply Chain for various fields, including supply chain, business, and engineering majors.

Position Summary

As a Supply Chain intern, you will be exposed to market analysis, sourcing, contracting, material management, logistics, analytics, and supplier relations. Specific results will be defined by the assigned project, which will differ for each intern. Supply Chain interns will participate in site wide internship activities such as field trips, seminars, social activities, and opportunities to meet senior management. Your supervisor and your mentor will provide mentorship and guidance throughout your internship as well as periodic performance evaluations.

Your internship will culminate with a presentation crafted to showcase your knowledge of your work assignments and other elements of your internship experience.

Assignments will typically be at our sites located in Houston, Texas or Midland, Texas. Typical length of our internships varies from 10 to 14 weeks based on the project and your availability.

Position Overview

Responsibilities may include:

  • Providing support in sourcing and contracting through market analysis, bidding, bid evaluation and negotiations
  • Combining analysis of market and/or internal spend trends to assess opportunities for value generation
  • Performing analysis and preparing dashboards that help in understanding supplier, category, and contract spend and leakage
  • Utilizing benchmarking, financial statements, market research sources, and public analyst reports to interpret market conditions and/or to evaluate suppliers’ performance
  • Working with suppliers and internal partners to improve transactional purchasing or eCommerce process execution
  • Performing Contract Analytics (spend to contract, price validation, contract leakage, unit price history) to aid in contract management activities
  • Identifying key cost drivers for a given category of spend and build or updating cost models
  • Interacting with suppliers on supplier performance management and contract assurance activities
  • Evaluating performance and opportunities for improving material management and/or logistics

Basic/Required:

  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis for anyone other than current employer and/or education institution
  • Pursuing a Bachelor's degree or higher in Business Administration, Economics, Energy Management, Energy Commerce, Finance, Industrial Distribution, Industrial Engineering, Logistics, Supply Chain Management, other related field, or foreign equivalent
  • Current level in college: Junior, Senior or Graduate Student
  • Expected graduation date: Fall 2027 through Spring/Fall 2028
  • A minimum of ten (10) continuous weeks availability for internship

Preferred:

  • Willing to work in either of these locations: Houston, TX or Midland, TX
  • A minimum cumulative and major GPA of 3.0 on a 4.0 scale
  • Previous internships or co-ops in an energy related field
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite
  • Awareness of upstream oil and gas operational supply chains
  • Ability to perform independent research in an assigned topic area
  • Flexibility to fulfill different roles within Supply Chain
  • Strong knowledge of spreadsheet and analytic tools
  • Builds effective solutions based on available information and makes timely decisions that are safe and ethical
  • Builds positive relationships based on trust and seeks collaboration across organizational boundaries to achieve goals

title: Civil / Structural BIM Engineer
description:
Tatu City is part of Rendeavour, Africa’s largest urban land developer with over 30,000 acres of visionary projects in the growth trajectories of large cities in Kenya, Ghana, Nigeria, Zambia and the Democratic Republic of Congo. Rendeavour’ s vision goes beyond alleviating a self-evident problem – stifling urban congestion and a dearth of quality housing and commercial property in Africa. Rather, we aim to help create the infrastructure – the living and working spaces, communities, schools and hospitals – that will help sustain and accelerate Africa’s economic growth, meet the aspirations of Africa’s burgeoning middle classes, and catalyse further urban development. Tatu City is a 4,500-acre, mixed-use special economic zone located approximately 25 km from the centre of Nairobi.

We are seeking a technically proficient and detail-oriented Civil/Structural BIM Engineer to join our innovative digital engineering team. This role is central to the successful delivery of our projects, focusing on the development, management, and coordination of intelligent 3D structural models. The ideal candidate will be an expert in BIM software and workflows, responsible for translating structural engineering designs into accurate and data-rich models. You will collaborate extensively with our design engineers and other disciplines to ensure a fully integrated and clash-free project model, driving efficiency and quality from design through to construction.

OVERALL RESPONSIBILITY

BIM Modeling & Management:

  • Develop, manage, and maintain accurate 3D BIM models for all structural components, including concrete, steel, and foundations, using software such as Revit.
  • Ensure all structural models are created in compliance with project-specific BIM Execution Plans (BEP) and company-wide standards.
  • Integrate structural models with architectural and MEP models, ensuring seamless coordination within a common data environment.
  • Manage and update the structural BIM model throughout the project lifecycle, incorporating design changes and maintaining version control.
  • Develop and manage parametric Revit families and other BIM content specific to structural project needs.

Coordination & Clash Detection:

  • Lead the structural coordination process by running regular clash detection analysis between the structural model and other discipline models (e.g., architecture, MEP) using Navisworks or similar software.
  • Identify, document, and collaborate with the design team to resolve all clashes and spatial conflicts related to structural elements in a timely manner.
  • Chair and participate in interdisciplinary BIM coordination meetings, presenting clash reports and facilitating solutions.
  • Ensure that the federated model is a single source of truth, accurately reflecting the coordinated design intent.

Documentation & Data Extraction:

  • Generate high-quality construction documents directly from the BIM model, including plans, sections, details, and schedules, ensuring accuracy and consistency.
  • Assist in the extraction of material quantities and other data from the BIM model to support cost estimation and procurement activities.
  • Support the creation of as-built documentation by updating models to reflect on-site conditions.
  • Contribute to the development of automated workflows for drawing production and data management to improve efficiency.

Requirements

Hard skills and experience:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Civil/Structural Engineering is required.
  • A minimum of three (3) years of dedicated experience in a structural BIM modelling or coordination role within the AEC industry.
  • Strong understanding of structural engineering principles, construction methodologies, and materials (concrete, steel, etc.).
  • Proven experience in creating and managing complex structural models for large-scale building projects.
  • Familiarity with international BIM standards and protocols, such as ISO 19650.

Advantageous Qualifications:

  • Autodesk Certified Professional (ACP) or other relevant software certifications.[29]
  • Experience with computational design tools (e.g., Dynamo) for automation.
  • Experience with Scan-to-BIM processes.

Soft skills:

  • Attention to Detail: Meticulous and precise in all modelling and documentation tasks to ensure model accuracy.
  • Problem-Solving: Strong analytical skills to identify and resolve complex model conflicts and design issues.
  • Collaboration: Excellent teamwork and communication skills to work effectively within a multi-disciplinary project team.
  • Organisational Skills: Ability to manage multiple tasks, prioritise effectively, and maintain clear documentation in a deadline-driven environment.

Personal Characteristics:

  • Technically-Minded: A passion for digital technology and its application in the construction industry.
  • Proactive: Identifies potential issues in the model and takes initiative to address them before they impact the project.
  • Organised: A systematic and methodical approach to model management and data control.
  • Team Player: A collaborative individual committed to the collective success of the project and the digital delivery team.

title: Target Security Specialist
description:
Starting Hourly Rate / Salario por Hora Inicial: $21.50 USD per hour

ALL ABOUT TARGET

Working at Target means helping all families discover the joy of everyday life. We bring that vision to life through our values and culture. Learn more about Target here.

ALL ABOUT ASSETS PROTECTION

Assets Protection (AP) teams function to keep our guests, team and brand secure and lead through crisis events. They protect profitable sales by mitigating shortage risks, preventing, and resolving theft and fraud to ensure product is available for our guest. They also build relationships inside and outside of Target, including store leaders and public safety officials, inclusive of law enforcement.

At Target, we believe in our team members having meaningful experiences that help them build and develop skills for a career. The role of a Target Security Specialist can provide you with the skills and experience of:

  • Using intelligence-led tactics to keep team members and guests safe and secure

  • Crisis response, safety and crowd management; providing support to both guests and team members

  • De-escalation as well as experience with physical security controls and culture

  • Using Target's video surveillance system

  • Timely and accurately documenting cases using case management systems

As a Target Security Specialist, no two days are ever the same, but a typical day will most likely include the following responsibilities:

  • Create an Easy, Inspiring and Friendly guest experience by delivering on the following commitments:

  • Greet:

  • 10ft: be friendly – smile, make eye contact, or wave

  • 4ft: greet the guest, smile and initiate a warm, helpful interaction

  • Help guests find what they need and/or resolve issues to ensure a smooth, easy shopping experience

  • End every guest transaction with a sincere thank you

  • Actively support team efforts and assist peers in other areas while maintaining a positive and respectful attitude

  • Adjust to business and guest needs to deliver an easy and inspiring guest experience

  • Promote a physical security culture for our team members and guests by assessing and maintaining safe and secure standards throughout the store, including exterior property.

  • Respond to and accurately document security incidents in a timely manner.

  • Appropriately respond to guest issues to provide a safe and secure environment for our team members and guests.

  • Leverage de-escalation tactics and resources when responding to security incidents across the store.

  • Conduct merchandise theft recoveries and provide theft apprehension support as needed, strictly adhering to AP policies.

  • Prevent theft and shortage at the front of store by performing merchandise receipt checks while adhering to AP policies, as well as recognizing and communicating trends.

  • Submit appropriate documentation in the case management system for all incidents following AP policy and procedures.

  • Understand and appropriately use Target's video surveillance system.

  • Demonstrate a culture of ethical conduct, safety and compliance.

  • Work in a safe manner at all times; comply with all safety policies, best practices, and training; report hazards and correct where possible.

  • All other duties based on business needs.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

This may be the right job for you if:

  • You enjoy interacting and helping others - including guests that shop our store and fellow team members you work with.

  • You thrive in a fast-moving, highly active and physically demanding role, where teamwork, flexibility, and creative problem solving are key to success.

  • You are open to working a flexible work schedule with varying hours, days or shifts (including nights, weekends, holidays and other peak shopping times).

The good news is that we have some amazing training that will help teach you everything you need to know to be a Target Security Specialist. But, there are a few skills you should have from the get-go:

  • Must be at least 18 years of age or older

  • High school diploma or equivalent

  • Meet any state or local licensure and/or other legal requirements related to the position

  • Welcoming and helpful attitude toward all guests and other team members

  • Ability to communicate on multiple frequency devices and operate handheld scanners, and other technology equipment as directed

  • Effective communication skills

  • Work both independently and with a team

  • Manage workload and prioritize tasks independently

  • Capability to remain focused and composed in a fast-paced environment and accomplish multiple tasks within established timeframes

We are an awesome place to work and care about our teams, so we want to make sure we are clear on a few more basics that we expect:

  • Climb up and down ladders

  • Apprehend subjects in accordance with company policy

  • Scan, handle and move merchandise efficiently and safely, including frequently lifting or moving merchandise up to 40 pounds without additional assistance from others

  • Flexible work schedule (e.g., nights, weekends and holidays); come to work when scheduled, work scheduled shifts and take required meal and rest breaks

  • Capable of working in and exposure to varying temperatures, humidity, and other elements while performing certain job duties including but not limited to Drive-Up, carryout, etc.

Assets Protection (AP) teams function to keep our guests, team and brand safe and secure and lead through crisis events. They protect profitable sales by mitigating shortage risks, preventing, investigating and resolving theft and fraud to ensure product is available for our guest.

title: Senior Systems Administrator
description:
TechFlow Inc. is an employee-owned company delivering mission-critical technology, engineering, and mission support services to federal government customers. We are seeking a Senior Systems Administrator to play a key role in a critical DOD program — powering the platform that securely collects, analyzes, reports, and exchanges data from Transportation Security Equipment. In this role, you will be responsible for the administration, maintenance, monitoring, and optimization of enterprise IT infrastructure supporting the customers platform, ensuring the stability, security, and availability of mission-critical systems through routine system administration, troubleshooting, and proactive corrective action. You will work closely with cybersecurity personnel, engineers, help desk staff, and government stakeholders to maintain a secure, high-performing operating environment — while collaborating alongside a highly technical team in a dynamic government setting.

Hybrid Remote: (Must have the ability to attend in person meetings Northern VA/DC Metro area)

Key Responsibilities

  • Administer, maintain, and support enterprise servers, operating systems, virtual environments, and associated infrastructure supporting the customers platform.
  • Perform routine system administration tasks, including user account management, system monitoring, patch management, backups, and performance tuning.
  • Maintain accurate system administration logs, operational documentation, and configuration records.
  • Monitor system health, identify performance issues, and implement corrective actions to maximize system availability and efficiency.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex hardware, software, operating system, network, and application issues in high-volume, high-availability environments.
  • Utilize established debugging tools, protocols, and diagnostic processes to isolate and resolve technical problems.
  • Respond to customer-reported incidents and service requests, providing timely resolution and effective communication throughout the support process.
  • Collaborate with cybersecurity personnel to implement security controls, apply security patches, and maintain compliance with government security requirements.
  • Support system upgrades, software deployments, maintenance activities, and infrastructure modernization initiatives.
  • Assist with disaster recovery planning, backup validation, and system restoration activities.
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, standard operating procedures, and configuration management records.
  • Participate in after-hours maintenance windows and provide on-call support as required.

Compensation: - $75,000 - $85,000 annually, commensurate with experience and qualifications.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline.
  • Minimum of 6 years of progressively responsible experience in systems administration.
  • Experience conducting routine system administration activities and maintaining detailed system administration logs.
  • Experience administering and troubleshooting enterprise IT infrastructure supporting high-volume, high-availability environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues across servers, operating systems, and supporting infrastructure.
  • Experience utilizing system debugging tools, troubleshooting methodologies, and diagnostic processes.
  • Strong understanding of Windows and/or Linux server administration.
  • Experience with system monitoring, patch management, backup solutions, and performance optimization.
  • Excellent analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to interact effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to obtain Public Trust Security Clearance.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting the federal government customers.
  • Experience with virtualization technologies such as VMware or Hyper-V.
  • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure and hybrid environments.
  • Experience with scripting or automation using PowerShell, Bash, or Python.
  • Knowledge of cybersecurity best practices, vulnerability remediation, and secure system administration.
  • Industry certifications such as Microsoft, Red Hat, VMware, Security+, Server+, or comparable credentials are a plus.

#techflow
