The role oversees the end-to-end lifecycle of operational changes across infrastructure, cloud, workplace, and business application environments, ensuring changes are assessed for risk, scheduled appropriately, communicated clearly, and implemented with minimal disruption. A key objective is to protect service stability and business continuity through robust change governance, effective stakeholder coordination, CAB leadership, and disciplined execution. The role also drives process standardization, reporting, compliance, and continual improvement to ensure a scalable, transparent, and business-aligned change management capability across all regions.

Candidate Success Factors

  • Embodying SCOR Values; Care, Collaboration, Courage, Open Mind and Integrity.
  • Striving for continuous improvement while enforcing Change Management procedures.

Objectives for the first year (or 2 years)

  • Maintain above SLAs for Delivery without sacrificing quality.
  • Abide to, and enforce, SCOR Tech, Data and AI principles and guidelines

Key duties and responsibilities

  • Own and lead SCOR’s operational change management process, ensuring changes are governed consistently and efficiently across regions and technology domains.

  • Chair or coordinate Change Advisory Board activities, ensuring the right stakeholders review, assess, and approve changes based on risk, impact, and urgency.

  • Define and enforce change policies, standards, workflows, and approval models for standard, normal, and emergency changes.

  • Assess change requests for operational risk, service impact, resource conflicts, scheduling constraints, and business readiness before implementation.

  • Coordinate change calendars, maintenance windows, and cross-team dependencies to minimize disruption and avoid conflicting activities.

  • Ensure strong communication to stakeholders before, during, and after changes, including business notifications, implementation status, and outcomes.

  • Monitor change execution quality, success rates, rollback activity, and unauthorized change trends, and drive corrective actions where required.

  • Lead post-implementation reviews for failed or high-risk changes, ensuring lessons learned are captured and process improvements are implemented.

  • Collaborate closely with engineering, operations, cybersecurity, application, release, and vendor teams to ensure coordinated and compliant change delivery.

  • Produce governance reporting and dashboards on change performance, risk exposure, audit readiness, and process compliance.

  • Drive continual improvement of the change management process through automation, simplification, policy updates, and control enhancements.

  • Promote a disciplined and collaborative change culture that supports service stability, transparency, and business confidence.

  • Contribute to Change management process definition and documentation.

  • Contribute to train and to coach all teams Technical and Functional regarding Change management procedures.

Required experience & competencies

  • 10+ years of experience in IT operations, service management, or governance, including significant experience in change management or release/change coordination leadership roles.

  • Proven track record managing enterprise change processes in complex, multi-regional environments with strong control and business alignment.

Soft skills

  • Good understanding of enterprise infrastructure, workplace services, cloud platforms such as Azure, business application delivery dependencies, and delivery best practices.

  • Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills, with the ability to balance priorities, speed, risk, and service stability.

  • Excellent stakeholder management, facilitation, leadership, and crisis coordination capabilities in a global and matrixed environment.

Hard skills

  • Strong ITIL expertise in change management, seeking efficient and reliable service delivery.

  • Strong expertise in change governance, risk assessment, CAB coordination, maintenance planning, and post-implementation review practices.

  • Experience with IT service management frameworks and tooling, including workflow governance, reporting, audit support, and process compliance.

Required Education

  • Degree in Computer Science, Management of Information Systems, or related analytical field; or equivalent experience

title: Advisor II, Record & Information Governance
description:
Phillips 66 & YOU - Together we can fuel the future

The Records & Information Governance (RIG) Advisor coordinates and operationalizes the enterprise-wide records and information governance program across structured and unstructured data. This role supports the development, rollout, and maintenance of policies, standards, processes, and tools that ensure information is accurate, secure, compliant, and usable in alignment with business objectives and legal, regulatory, and contractual requirements. The role partners with Legal, Compliance, Privacy, Information Security, IT, and business teams to ensure consistent execution, measurable adoption, and strong cross functional integration. The RIG Advisor coordinates program activities, maintains governance artifacts, and ensures lifecycle controls from information creation through retention, legal hold, and defensible disposition. Responsibilities include operationalizing classification, taxonomy/metadata, data mapping, archival practices, and supporting governance tools. The role also manages communications, training logistics, and governance forums. Close collaboration with Legal includes eDiscovery readiness, legal hold administration, retention schedule maintenance, and defensible disposition. Coordination with Privacy and Security ensures lifecycle controls align with privacy‑by‑design and data protection standards. The Advisor tracks metrics, risks, and issues, and prepares reporting for leadership and audit stakeholders.

What You'll Do

  • Coordinate day to day execution of the Enterprise Information Governance (EIG) Program across structured and unstructured data.
  • Maintain EIG program plans, timelines, status, risks, and action items, support Steering and Advisory Committees and Accountability Networks.
  • Maintain and update governance artifacts (enterprise retention schedule, data inventories/maps, standards, procedures, playbooks).
  • Operationalize information lifecycle controls from creation through classification, retention, legal hold, archival, and defensible disposition.
  • Support implementation and maintenance of classification schemes, taxonomies/metadata, data maps, archival/disposition rules, and governance tools.
  • Partner with Legal, Compliance, Privacy, Information Security, IT, and business teams to embed governance requirements into systems and processes.
  • Support eDiscovery readiness and legal hold process administration in partnership with Legal Ops.
  • Coordinate and execute communications, training logistics, and governance forums to drive adoption of information governance practices.
  • Track and report program metrics, risks, issues, and status for leadership and audit stakeholders
  • Assist with records acquisition, transfer, and disposition activities related to mergers, acquisitions, and divestitures, ensuring information is identified, evaluated, and managed in accordance with enterprise retention, legal, privacy, and security requirements.

What You'll Bring – Required

  • Legally authorized to work in the job posting country
  • Bachelor’s degree
  • 2 or more years of experience in information governance, records management, or data governance
  • 1 or more years of experience coordinating cross functional projects or programs
  • Intermediate proficiency with M365 and collaboration/content management tools; comfort learning governance or data catalog tools
  • Intermediate proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other analytics/reporting tools for data analysis and visualization

What Makes You Stand Out – Preferred

  • Professional credentials such as IGP, CRM/CRA, CIP, CIPP, or similar information governance / records / privacy certifications
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to create clear documentation, summaries, and presentations
  • Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with high attention to detail and data quality
  • Familiarity with records retention, privacy, and/or data protection requirements

Compensation Range

This position has a base salary range of $108,900 - $133,100.

At Phillips 66, we are committed to pay transparency and competitive, equitable compensation. Each role is assigned a salary grade with a defined pay range, benchmarked against industry peers. Where a candidate offer falls within the posted range depends on the candidate's experience, skills, and alignment with the role’s requirements. Offers are made to ensure internal equity and market competitiveness. Our compensation programs are designed to reward performance and support career growth.

Total Rewards

At Phillips 66, providing access to high quality programs and care for you and your family is important to us. Maintaining a culture of well-being — physical, emotional, social, and financial — is essential for a high-performing organization. When we are at our best, we are poised to deliver exceptional results — personally and professionally. Benefits for certain eligible, full-time employees include:

  • Annual Variable Cash Incentive Program (VCIP) bonus
  • 8% 401k company match
  • Cash Balance Account pension
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits with an annual company contribution to a Health Savings Account for employees on HDHP
  • Total well-being programs and incentives, including Employee Assistance Plan, well-being reimbursement, and backup family care services

Learn more about Phillips 66 Total Rewards.

Phillips 66 has more than 140 years of experience in providing the energy that enables people to dream bigger and go farther, faster. We are committed to improving lives, and that is our promise to our employees and our communities. We are sustained by the backgrounds and experiences of our diverse teams, which reflect who we are, the environment we create and how we work together. title: Field Architect
description:
The company is seeking a meticulous and experienced Field Architect to join the Jabali Towers site team. This is a hands-on, site-based role focused on translating design excellence into construction reality. The Field Architect will be the on-site custodian of the architectural design intent, responsible for the day-to-day inspection and quality control of all architectural works, from the building envelope to the finest interior details.

On-Site Design Integrity & Quality Assurance:

  • Serve as the primary on-site custodian of the architectural design intent, ensuring all works are executed in precise accordance with the approved drawings, specifications, and quality benchmarks.
  • Conduct rigorous daily inspections of all architectural works, including facade and curtain wall installation, waterproofing, blockwork, plastering, and all interior finishes (tiling, flooring, joinery, painting).
  • Implement and enforce the project's Quality Assurance/Quality Control (QA/QC) program for all architectural components, managing the approval process for material samples and full-scale mock-ups.
  • Review and provide technical approval for contractor submittals, including shop drawings, method statements, and material data sheets for all architectural elements.
  • Proactively identify and resolve discrepancies between the design documents and site conditions, ensuring any necessary changes are properly documented and approved without compromising design quality.

Technical Coordination & Problem-Solving:

  • Interpret complex architectural drawings and details to provide clear guidance to the contractor's site team.
  • Liaise directly with the lead architectural consultant to manage and resolve technical queries (RFIs) in a timely manner.
  • Coordinate closely with the MEP and Structural field engineers to ensure the correct installation of service penetrations, in-wall/in-slab services, and partition set-outs relative to the structure.
  • Assist in maintaining accurate site records, including daily progress reports, inspection logs, and photographic evidence of the works.

Safety & Compliance:

  • Champion a culture of safety for all architectural works, with a particular focus on facade installation, scaffolding, and work in common areas and finished spaces.
  • Ensure all architectural installations are in full compliance with Kenyan building codes, local authority regulations, and international best practices.
  • Monitor contractor operations to ensure strict adherence to approved health and safety plans and procedures.

Requirements

Hard skills and experience:

  • Education: A bachelor's degree in Architecture from an internationally recognized university is essential.
  • Experience: A minimum of 10-15 years of direct, post-graduate experience as a site-based architect on large-scale construction projects. A proven track record on high-rise buildings with high-end finishes is mandatory.
  • Industry Background: Extensive hands-on experience working for major international main contractors, construction supervision consultants, or architectural firms with a strong site supervision presence is critical.
  • International Exposure: Demonstrable, hands-on international project experience in challenging construction environments is essential.
  • Technical Proficiency: Expert knowledge of building construction, with specialized expertise in facade systems (curtain walls, cladding), waterproofing details, and high-quality interior finishing. Must possess an exceptional ability to read and interpret detailed architectural drawings.
  • Software Proficiency: Proficiency in AutoCAD and Revit is required for reviewing shop drawings. Experience with Bluebeam Revu or similar markup software is advantageous.

Soft skills:

  • Attention to Detail: A forensic level of attention to detail and an uncompromising commitment to quality. This is the single most important attribute for the role.
  • Problem-Solving: Strong analytical skills with the ability to provide swift, practical, and aesthetically-sensitive solutions to technical challenges that arise on site.
  • Communication: Excellent verbal, written, and graphic communication skills, capable of effectively conveying design requirements to contractors and liaising with senior designers.
  • Assertiveness: A firm and professional demeanor with the ability to enforce quality standards and reject non-compliant work when necessary.
  • Integrity: An unwavering commitment to professional integrity and ensuring the final built product is a true reflection of the design intent.
  • Ownership: A hands-on, proactive professional who takes full ownership of their inspection and supervision responsibilities and is driven by the pursuit of architectural excellence on site.

title: Clerk of Works- Interior Fit Out
description:
Job Details:

Reporting Line : Quantity Survey Manager

Role Overview:

The Clerk of Works will be responsible for executing and coordinating the delivery of interior fit-out works. This role requires active, hands-on approach to overseeing site activities, managing trade coordination, resolving technical issues, and making progress to ensure high-quality execution of interior works. The position works closely with design and site teams to support the timely and cost-effective completion of interior projects.

Responsibilities:

Hands-On Delivery & Site Coordination

  • Lead and coordinate day-to-day interior fit-out activities on site for the residential house project.
  • Manage the sequencing and integration of trades including partitions, ceilings, joinery, tiling, flooring, decorative finishes, and MEP interfaces.
  • Provide technical direction to contractors and subcontractors, ensuring works follow the agreed programme and meet quality expectations.
  • Oversee installation of fixtures, fittings, equipment, appliances, sanitary ware, bespoke joinery, cabinetry, and specialist interior elements.
  • Prepare short-term work plans to maintain momentum and ensure site readiness for upcoming trades.
  • Maintain detailed daily site logs documenting progress, workforce, material usage, and emerging issues.

Technical Execution & Problem Solving

  • Resolve design, detailing, construction, and buildability issues directly on site, producing sketches, clarifications, or technical notes as required.
  • Coordinate closely with the design team to refine installation details for joinery, stonework, bathrooms, kitchens, lighting, and high-spec residential finishes.
  • Develop or contribute to method statements, construction sequencing plans, and installation strategies for interior components.
  • Verify field measurements and “as-built” conditions, ensuring all dimensions and levels align with design requirements before installation.
  • Produce installation sketches or detail instructions for contractors where design gaps or clashes exist.

Materials, Samples, and Mock-Up Management

  • Coordinate procurement and delivery of interior materials, ensuring correct quantities, specifications, and timely arrival.
  • Review and present physical samples and mock-ups for client or design team approval, ensuring alignment with design intent and quality expectations.
  • Manage proper storage, handling, protection, and on-site quality of all interior finishes and specialist materials (timber, stone, metals, fabrics, etc.).
  • Liaise directly with suppliers, manufacturers, and specialist subcontractors for joinery, kitchen systems, wardrobes, lighting systems, and custom elements.
  • Track and maintain a material and finishes register, ensuring all selections and approvals are documented.

Quality Assurance & Residential-Specific Deliverables

  • Prepare quality checklists for key residential spaces including kitchens, bathrooms, bedrooms, wardrobes, staircases, and living areas.
  • Conduct progressive inspections, identify defects, and manage close-out until works meet the required standard.
  • Document all progress and concealed works through structured photographic records.
  • Prepare and manage snag lists/punch lists leading up to handover, ensuring smooth completion.
  • Verify compliance with installation guidelines, building regulations, fire safety provisions, and manufacturer requirements.

Coordination, Reporting & Client Interface

  • Manage RFIs, design clarifications, and client instructions through a structured register.
  • Coordinate with all trades to ensure seamless interface between interior architecture and MEP systems.
  • Provide regular progress updates, reports, and issue logs to the client or Quantity Survey manager.
  • Support homeowner walkthroughs, prepare action lists, and track resolution of outstanding items.

Handover & Close-Out

  • Coordinate testing and commissioning activities related to interior elements (e.g., lighting controls, appliances, joinery-integrated services).
  • Assist in preparing as-built information, warranties, certificates, and O&M manuals.
  • Deliver a final completion report summarizing works, quality status, and outstanding actions.
  • Provide a care and maintenance guide for finishes and installed components.

Requirements

  • Diploma or undergraduate degree in relevant subjects include building studies, construction, surveying or engineering
  • Minimum 7 years’ experience in delivering high-quality interior finishing works.
  • Proven experience in commercial and/or residential interior fit-out projects, with strong knowledge of finishing standards and installation processes.

title: Target Security Specialist
description:
Starting Hourly Rate / Salario por Hora Inicial: $20.75 USD per hour

ALL ABOUT TARGET

Working at Target means helping all families discover the joy of everyday life. We bring that vision to life through our values and culture. Learn more about Target here.

ALL ABOUT ASSETS PROTECTION

Assets Protection (AP) teams function to keep our guests, team and brand secure and lead through crisis events. They protect profitable sales by mitigating shortage risks, preventing, and resolving theft and fraud to ensure product is available for our guest. They also build relationships inside and outside of Target, including store leaders and public safety officials, inclusive of law enforcement.

At Target, we believe in our team members having meaningful experiences that help them build and develop skills for a career. The role of a Target Security Specialist can provide you with the skills and experience of:

  • Using intelligence-led tactics to keep team members and guests safe and secure

  • Crisis response, safety and crowd management; providing support to both guests and team members

  • De-escalation as well as experience with physical security controls and culture

  • Using Target's video surveillance system

  • Timely and accurately documenting cases using case management systems

As a Target Security Specialist, no two days are ever the same, but a typical day will most likely include the following responsibilities:

  • Create an Easy, Inspiring and Friendly guest experience by delivering on the following commitments:

  • Greet:

  • 10ft: be friendly – smile, make eye contact, or wave

  • 4ft: greet the guest, smile and initiate a warm, helpful interaction

  • Help guests find what they need and/or resolve issues to ensure a smooth, easy shopping experience

  • End every guest transaction with a sincere thank you

  • Actively support team efforts and assist peers in other areas while maintaining a positive and respectful attitude

  • Adjust to business and guest needs to deliver an easy and inspiring guest experience

  • Promote a physical security culture for our team members and guests by assessing and maintaining safe and secure standards throughout the store, including exterior property.

  • Respond to and accurately document security incidents in a timely manner.

  • Appropriately respond to guest issues to provide a safe and secure environment for our team members and guests.

  • Leverage de-escalation tactics and resources when responding to security incidents across the store.

  • Conduct merchandise theft recoveries and provide theft apprehension support as needed, strictly adhering to AP policies.

  • Prevent theft and shortage at the front of store by performing merchandise receipt checks while adhering to AP policies, as well as recognizing and communicating trends.

  • Submit appropriate documentation in the case management system for all incidents following AP policy and procedures.

  • Understand and appropriately use Target's video surveillance system.

  • Demonstrate a culture of ethical conduct, safety and compliance.

  • Work in a safe manner at all times; comply with all safety policies, best practices, and training; report hazards and correct where possible.

  • All other duties based on business needs.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

This may be the right job for you if:

  • You enjoy interacting and helping others - including guests that shop our store and fellow team members you work with.

  • You thrive in a fast-moving, highly active and physically demanding role, where teamwork, flexibility, and creative problem solving are key to success.

  • You are open to working a flexible work schedule with varying hours, days or shifts (including nights, weekends, holidays and other peak shopping times).

The good news is that we have some amazing training that will help teach you everything you need to know to be a Target Security Specialist. But, there are a few skills you should have from the get-go:

  • High school diploma or equivalent

  • Meet any state or local licensure and/or other legal requirements related to the position

  • Welcoming and helpful attitude toward all guests and other team members

  • Ability to communicate on multiple frequency devices and operate handheld scanners, and other technology equipment as directed

  • Effective communication skills

  • Work both independently and with a team

  • Manage workload and prioritize tasks independently

  • Capability to remain focused and composed in a fast-paced environment and accomplish multiple tasks within established timeframes

We are an awesome place to work and care about our teams, so we want to make sure we are clear on a few more basics that we expect:

  • Climb up and down ladders

  • Apprehend subjects in accordance with company policy

  • Scan, handle and move merchandise efficiently and safely, including frequently lifting or moving merchandise up to 40 pounds without additional assistance from others

  • Flexible work schedule (e.g., nights, weekends and holidays); come to work when scheduled, work scheduled shifts and take required meal and rest breaks

  • Capable of working in and exposure to varying temperatures, humidity, and other elements while performing certain job duties including but not limited to Drive-Up, carryout, etc.

title: Head of Engineering & Product Delivery – Pricing, Modelling & Accumulation
description:

The Head of Engineering & Product Delivery ensures that business priorities are translated into technically sound product and platform outcomes, that architecture and engineering decisions align with strategic goals, cross-team dependencies are actively managed, and that delivery results in a coherent, resilient and maintainable technology landscape.

You will work closely with business, product, architecture, data, AI, risk and engineering teams. Your role is to provide the technical leadership, product delivery discipline and cross-functional coordination needed to turn complex business objectives into scalable and reliable platforms that generate measurable value.

The challenge in this domain is not simply building features. It is leading engineering across multiple teams and technical components while preserving architectural integrity, product coherence, operational resilience, maintainability and business relevance.

  • Manage technical and delivery dependencies, risks, priorities and trade-offs across teams to ensure smooth and coordinated execution.

  • Provide senior leadership on solution design, architecture, engineering standards and key technology decisions.

  • Ensure strong alignment between data, models, business rules, APIs, integration patterns and business applications.

  • Partner closely with business, product, architecture, data, AI, risk and engineering teams to align outcomes, sequencing, trade-offs and execution.

  • Drive decision-making and resolve delivery challenges, ensuring progress against agreed objectives, timelines, quality standards and operational expectations.

  • Balance business value, user needs, technical feasibility, architectural integrity, operational resilience and long-term sustainability in engineering decisions.

  • Drive adoption of AI-enabled practices where they improve engineering productivity, platform capabilities, model operations and decision support.

  • Communicate technical direction, product delivery progress, risks, dependencies and trade-offs clearly to senior stakeholders.

  • Promote continuous improvement in engineering practices, product delivery, Agile ways of working, DevOps, quality engineering, observability and production operations.

  • Ensure delivered solutions generate measurable business value and strong product outcomes while remaining secure, reliable, maintainable and operationally efficient.

  • Provide leadership, coaching and line management for the Product team, including objective setting, performance development, talent management and capability building.

  • Build and maintain a high-performing engineering and product organization with a strong culture of accountability, collaboration, technical excellence, customer focus and risk awareness.

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Actuarial Science, Data Science, Business, Product Management, or equivalent relevant experience

  • Significant experience in software engineering, platform engineering, technical delivery and engineering leadership

  • Proven experience leading large engineering domains, including internal teams and external partners

  • Experience shaping technical roadmaps, delivery plans and product outcomes in partnership with product and business stakeholders

  • Strong understanding of modern software architecture, cloud platforms, APIs, integration patterns, data platforms, and model execution environments

  • Strong knowledge of software development best practices, Agile methodologies, DevOps principles, observability, production operations and engineering governance

  • Experience orchestrating technical and product delivery across multiple squads, applications, services and cross-functional teams while preserving architectural integrity

  • portfolio analytics and decision-support platforms

title: Executive Director
description:
About Our Organization

This position supports one of the trusted behavioral health programs within the Advanced Recovery Systems family. Advanced Recovery Systems is the parent organization of Promises Behavioral Health, The Right Step, and The Ranch, bringing together established treatment brands with a shared commitment to expanding access to high-quality, evidence-based addiction and mental health care.

While you may work primarily with a specific facility or brand, you will be part of a larger, growing organization focused on improving patient outcomes, supporting our employees and strengthening the communities we serve.

At the Washburn House addiction treatment center in Worcester, Massachusetts, we strive to provide a higher level of care. Our vision includes constantly enhancing and perfecting our techniques to provide our clients with the best therapeutic options possible. Through a close knit community of staff, residents, and family, we can build a brand new life for our clients.

The Executive Director is responsible for all aspects of operations at the assigned facility(s); including clinical functions/activities, developing, and implementing plans for enhancing productivity, compliance, and profitability. title: Compiler Engineer
description:
Job Details:

Job Description:

Join Us in Shaping the Future At Intel, we are building the next generation of software innovation through the oneAPI software stack, a unified programming model designed to unlock the full potential of heterogeneous computing.

Our team is at the forefront of enabling developers worldwide to harness CPUs, GPUs, and accelerators with cutting-edge tools, libraries, and compilers. By joining us, you'll contribute to an open ecosystem that drives performance, scalability, and portability across diverse architectures-empowering breakthroughs in AI, HPC, and beyond. If you're passionate about transforming how the world computes and want to work on technology that truly matters, this is your opportunity to make an impact.

The Intel Compiler Engineering Team is a high-performing team responsible for creating the industry-leading Intel C/C++/DPC++ and Fortran Compilers and is a leader in LLVM.org, the foundation of our compiler products. We are continually pushing the boundaries of compiler technology in support of providing maximally useful and performant compilers for all of Intel's processor platforms, both CPU and GPUs.

We're hiring a motivated and experienced Compiler Engineer to help us develop and advance our open-source compiler stack in support of our latest CPU and GPU accelerators.

In this role, you will:

  • Help set the technical direction, design and evolve the language extensions, runtimes, and features that enable portable, high-performance offload for our processor platforms.
  • Collaborate with many in LLVM.org, as well as our worldwide compiler and runtimes teams - everything we do is based on open standards and LLVM.
  • Help to ensure our language extensions and runtime integrates with the broader ecosystem, and ensure rock-solid performance, reliability, and developer experience from silicon to software.

This role is perfect for individuals who thrive on deep systems work, community leadership, and measurable impact on AI and HPC workloads.

Qualifications:

Minimum Qualifications:

  • BS in Computer Science or related field with 4+ years of relevant experience, or MS with 2+ years
  • 4+ years of hands-on compiler development experience with a demonstrated history of technical contributions to LLVM.org (commit history, patches, reviews).
  • 3+ years of experience with accelerated computing and parallel programming models working with GPU architecture.
  • 3+ years of experience in compiler or application performance tuning to achieve optimal runtime and application throughput.
  • Expert-level C/C++with deep understanding of systems programming.

Nice to have:

  • Hardware knowledge: understanding of modern CPU, GPU, and accelerator architecture.
  • Ability to analyse and optimise language runtimes, scheduling, and memory models to achieve industry-leading runtime and application performance across heterogeneous architectures (CPU, GPU, and accelerators).
  • Patents or significant technical innovations in compiler technology.
  • Demonstrated cross-industry collaboration on language standards and specifications.

Requirements listed would be obtained through a combination of industry-relevant job experience, internship experiences and or schoolwork/classes/research.

title: Construction Supervisor - Mechanical
description:
The role involves the direct on-site supervision of the complete installation, testing, and commissioning of all mechanical systems. Responsibilities include managing the daily activities of MEP subcontractors, ensuring strict adherence to approved drawings and specifications, monitoring progress, and enforcing all quality and safety protocols.

The position requires a seasoned mechanical construction professional with deep, practical knowledge of modern MEP systems, particularly in a high-rise context. The Construction Supervisor will be a critical link between the engineering team and the on-site workforce, responsible for ensuring the successful execution of all mechanical works from the basement plant rooms to the rooftop equipment.

Responsibilities:

1. On-Site Supervision & Installation Management:

  • Provide direct, hands-on supervision of all mechanical system installation activities on a daily basis, including HVAC (chillers, pumps, AHUs, ductwork), plumbing & drainage, fire protection (sprinklers, standpipes), and gas systems.
  • Manage and coordinate the daily work of the mechanical subcontractors, ensuring that all installation teams are working efficiently, safely, and in accordance with the approved program.
  • Monitor site productivity and progress against the weekly and daily work plans, proactively identifying and resolving any issues related to manpower, materials, or equipment that may impact the schedule.
  • Interpret complex mechanical drawings, schematics, and specifications to ensure that all systems are installed correctly and in full compliance with the design intent.

2. Quality Control & Assurance:

  • Act as the frontline enforcer of the project's quality standards for all mechanical works, conducting continuous inspections of workmanship, materials, and installation practices.
  • Ensure all installations comply with project specifications and international standards (e.g., SMACNA, NFPA, IPC).
  • Raise formal inspection requests (IRs) for all completed mechanical works and coordinate with the Field Engineer and QA/QC team to ensure timely approvals.
  • Witness and verify key quality checks, including ductwork leakage testing, pipe pressure testing, and initial equipment pre-power checks.

3. Health, Safety & Environment (HSE):

  • Champion a culture of safety for all mechanical works, with a particular focus on high-risk activities such as heavy equipment lifting (chillers, AHUs), hot works (welding), and working in confined spaces.
  • Lead daily site safety walks (Toolbox Talks) for mechanical teams, ensuring all workers are following safe work procedures and using the correct PPE.
  • Review subcontractor's method statements and risk assessments for all mechanical installation activities.
  • Ensure a high standard of housekeeping is maintained in all mechanical work areas.

4. Coordination & Reporting:

  • Prepare accurate daily and weekly site reports detailing the progress of mechanical works, resource allocation, and any delays or technical challenges encountered.
  • Liaise closely with the Mechanical Field Engineer to resolve technical queries and ensure all works are approved before concealment.
  • Coordinate proactively with other discipline supervisors (Electrical, Civil) to ensure smooth integration of services and avoid clashes on site.
  • Assist in tracking the delivery and proper storage of all major mechanical equipment and materials

Requirements

  • A diploma, higher national diploma, or trade certificate in Mechanical Engineering or a related field is essential. A bachelor's degree is a significant advantage.
  • A minimum of 10-15 years of direct, hands-on experience in a mechanical construction supervision role (e.g., Mechanical Foreman, General Foreman, MEP Superintendent) on large-scale building projects. Experience on high-rise towers is highly advantageous.
  • Extensive experience working for a major MEP subcontractor or a main contractor with a strong self-perform MEP division is mandatory.
  • Expert practical knowledge of the installation, testing, and commissioning of a wide range of mechanical systems, including chilled water systems, large-scale ductwork, vertical plumbing risers, and fire protection systems.
  • Must be highly skilled in reading and interpreting complex mechanical and plumbing drawings, P&IDs, and coordination drawings.

title: Orientation and Mobility Specialist
description:
About Us

TheraPeds Partners is a therapist-owned and operated organization. We partner with schools to provide Orientation and Mobility specialists (O&M) services to PreK–12 students nationwide. As a team of special education providers, we understand the education process, IDEA requirements, and the importance of collaboration within multidisciplinary teams. Our mission is to deliver high-quality O&M (SPED) services while making meaningful connections in a collaborative learning environment.

Job Description and Responsibilities

This is a full-time, on-site role as a Orientation Mobility Specialist serving a school located in Spartanburg, SC.

The Orientation and Mobility Specialist (O&M) will be responsible for providing direct services to students, conducting assessments, developing IEP plans, evaluating progress, and collaborating with interdisciplinary teams (therapists, educators, parents). The role requires strong communication and interpersonal skills, as well as a passion for working with students with special needs.

Job Details

  • Full-time 37.5 hours/week
  • 2026-2027 School year, August - May/June.
  • On-site, in-person
  • PreK – 12 grades
  • Dual support from the District and TheraPeds
  • Competitive pay
  • Job duties: educational services, case management, evaluations
  • Guaranteed hours, including documentation, administrative and planning time
  • $65.00– $85.00+/hour ($2437 - $3187/week)

Responsibilities

  • Develop, implement, and assess individualized education plans (IEPs) for students with disabilities.
  • Deliver instruction tailored to meet the diverse learning styles and needs of students.
  • Collaborate with parents, educators, and specialists to ensure a comprehensive approach to student learning and support.
  • Assess school campuses for travel safety
  • Recommend environmental modifications
  • Help plan safe travel routes around the school
  • Monitor student progress and adapt instructional strategies to improve outcomes.
  • Provide one-on-one or small group instruction
  • Tailor lessons based on the student’s vision level, age, and mobility needs
  • Adjust strategies for students with additional disabilities
  • Maintain accurate records of student performance, behavior, and progress to inform ongoing instruction and planning.
  • Create a welcoming, safe, and productive classroom environment that encourages positive behavior and learning.
  • Provide guidance and support to classroom staff in implementing educational strategies for students with special needs.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree required; graduate degree in Orientation & Mobility, Vision Studies, or related field preferred
  • COMS Certification (ACVREP) required or preferred
  • 1+ years of experience in a school setting preferred
  • Experience working with children with visual impairments
  • Knowledge of orientation and mobility assessments and instruction
  • Organizational and time management skills
  • Proficient in use of technology
  • Fingerprint background clearance
  • Ability to collaborate with school staff and parents with a demonstrated ability to exercise a high level of tact and discretion in both internal and external communications

Physical Requirements

Working and playing with students requires that employees must be able to perform the necessary physical movement functions, as needed, such as lifting, sitting, walking, standing, crawling, and engaging with students in all physical locations and activities, while adhering to the duties outlined by the district.

Benefits

Benefits (eligibility dependent on employment status)

  • Competitive compensation package with benefits including health, dental, and vision and 401K (W2)
  • Resources for health benefit enrollment and hourly rates which includes a stipend for health benefits and taxes (1099)
  • Opportunities for professional development and continuing education
  • Access to a supportive network within the TheraPeds community
  • Guaranteed Hours
  • Bi-Monthly Salary Deposits
  • This position will be a W-2 employee or a 1099 contractor

TheraPeds Partners is seeking a Full-time, on-site Orientation and Mobility Specialist (O&M) for a school-based position in Spartanburg, SC. title: Technical Writer
description:
TechFlow is seeking a Technical Writer / Documentation Specialist to support a mission-critical DoD software development and modernization program in Montgomery, AL. This program provides software development and technical support services to sustain, enhance, and optimize a critical customer system through secure, scalable, and maintainable software solutions.

The Technical Writer will develop, maintain, and manage comprehensive technical documentation supporting the full software development lifecycle, including system design, software architecture, user documentation, operational procedures, and acquisition artifacts. Working closely with software engineers, architects, database administrators, DevSecOps engineers, testers, and program leadership, this role will ensure technical documentation is accurate, current, well organized, and compliant with Department of Defense documentation standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Create, edit, and maintain technical documentation supporting software development, system sustainment, acquisition activities, and lifecycle management.
  • Develop and maintain software requirements documentation, business use cases, functional specifications, process workflows, system design documents, architecture diagrams, database schemas, and data dictionaries.
  • Produce and maintain user guides, system administration manuals, training materials, release notes, installation guides, and operational documentation.
  • Document ETL processes, including data source descriptions, transformation logic, report generation procedures, and data flow documentation.
  • Develop and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs), troubleshooting guides, maintenance procedures, and system monitoring documentation.
  • Establish and maintain version-controlled documentation repositories using Government-approved version control systems to ensure document integrity and traceability.
  • Develop and maintain documentation standards, templates, and style guides to promote consistency across program deliverables.
  • Collaborate with technical teams to gather information, translate complex technical concepts into clear documentation, and ensure documentation remains synchronized with system changes.
  • Support Government risk management activities by documenting risks, mitigation strategies, action items, and program decisions within approved project management tools.
  • Leverage Government-approved generative AI and digital authoring tools to improve documentation quality, consistency, efficiency, and standardization while ensuring compliance with program requirements.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies and support documentation updates throughout each sprint to ensure deliverables remain current.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree (or equivalent experience) in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or related field.
  • Minimum 3 years of technical writing experience supporting DoD software development or modernization programs.
  • Experience creating technical documentation for software systems, system architecture, user documentation, and operational procedures.
  • Experience working with version-controlled documentation repositories and collaborative documentation platforms.
  • Proficiency using Government-approved generative AI tools and modern digital authoring technologies to support documentation development.
  • Familiarity with DoD acquisition documentation standards and software lifecycle documentation requirements.
  • Excellent written communication, editing, organization, and document management skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with engineers, developers, project managers, and Government stakeholders.
  • Active Secret Security Clearance

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting U.S. Air Force software development or modernization programs.
  • Familiarity with Agile software development methodologies and Scrum environments.
  • Experience documenting cloud-based applications, DevSecOps processes, CI/CD pipelines, and database architectures.
  • Experience creating architecture diagrams and technical illustrations using tools such as Visio, Lucidchart, or similar platforms.
  • Knowledge of RMF documentation, cybersecurity documentation, and configuration management processes.
  • Experience working with Git-based repositories or other version control systems for documentation management.

Benefits

Founded in 1995 at the start of the dot-com revolution, TechFlow helped large commercial clients such as DreamWorks, Toshiba, MGM, and others modernize their business systems. Today, with deep operational roots in the bi-coastal innovation hubs of California and Washington DC, TechFlow continues as a leader in applying innovative engineering, technology, integration solutions, and support services to the Federal Government’s most demanding mission and business challenges.

Our culture thrives on out-of-the-box thinking and the unique powerful entrepreneurial expressions of our employee-owners. As a 100% employee-owned company, we have a shared expectation of commitment, accountability, and responsibility driven by a culture that embraces innovation and new ideas. Our goal is not to do what has been done, but to do it better.

TechFlow has four principal lines of business: Platform Services, Digital Services, Base Operations and Energy and Mobility Solutions. Our company has a strong track record of successful contracts in both areas and encourages cross-collaboration.

TechFlow, Inc is 100% employee-owned. Come make a difference in a job that contributes to your future and helps us build an agile workplace!

title: Director of Inventory Planning and Optimization
description:
Our partner is looking for a Director of Inventory Planning and Optimization in Barrington, NJ. This role leads the organization's global inventory strategy while remaining closely engaged in the analytical and planning work that drives decision-making. It requires a highly analytical leader who is comfortable working with data, exploring models, and guiding the development of insights in a hands-on and collaborative way. The Director partners closely with Operations, Finance, and Executive Leadership to balance service levels, cost, and risk across the supply chain while driving continuous improvement in inventory performance. As the organization continues to evolve its analytics capabilities, this individual will play a key role in shaping tools, processes, and team capabilities — balancing strategic leadership with a practical understanding of how the work gets done.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the development and execution of the global inventory strategy to support objectives for service levels, cost efficiency, and working capital.
  • Direct the evolution of demand forecasting strategies, processes, and systems to ensure accurate planning and alignment with sales and operational requirements.
  • Manage and optimize inventory planning tools, software platforms, and analytics systems used to forecast and manage inventory across the organization.
  • Establish and monitor key performance metrics, including service levels, fill rates, inventory turns, and shipping reliability, to ensure high levels of customer satisfaction.
  • Develop and manage annual inventory forecasts for finished goods across all sales plants.
  • Collaborate with Finance and Supply Chain executives to establish and manage working capital targets, including total inventory value and days of inventory by sales plant.
  • Drive data-driven decision-making through advanced analytics, reporting, and modeling to identify risks, opportunities, and inefficiencies within the inventory network.
  • Work closely with Finance and Supply Chain executives on end-of-life, excess, and scrap inventory initiatives to minimize financial exposure.
  • Identify and implement process improvements, system enhancements, and best practices to increase forecasting accuracy and inventory efficiency.
  • Ensure compliance with internal controls, audit requirements, and inventory management policies.

Requirements

Required Skills & Abilities:

  • Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with a solid understanding of statistical concepts and their application in forecasting and inventory optimization.
  • Hands-on experience with inventory planning and ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, or similar platforms).
  • Expert in advanced analytics tools and reporting systems (e.g., Excel modeling, BI tools such as Power BI or Tableau).
  • Working knowledge of SQL or other advanced database programming preferred.
  • Experience working with Snowflake or similar cloud-based data platforms a plus.
  • Demonstrated success improving working capital, inventory turns, and service level KPIs.
  • Strong understanding of supply chain processes, including S&OP, production planning, and demand/supply balancing.
  • Ability to engage directly with data and analysis, guiding and validating outputs while supporting team execution.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and collaboration skills with the ability to translate data into clear, actionable business recommendations.
  • Comfort operating in an environment where analytics capabilities are evolving, with a willingness to help build and mature processes over time.
  • Optics and optical industry knowledge a plus.
  • Comfortable in a multi-cultural/global environment.
  • Strong customer focus.

Education/Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Analytics, Finance, Operations, or a related field (Master's degree preferred).
  • 10+ years of experience in inventory management, supply chain planning, or operations.
  • 5+ years of leadership experience managing teams and cross-functional initiatives.
  • Proven experience in demand planning, forecasting, and inventory optimization in a complex, multi-location environment.

Physical Requirements:

  • Ability to operate standard office equipment such as a copier.
  • Ability to sit or stand for extended periods.
  • Ability to work in an office setting.
  • Ability to travel 10–20%.

Benefits

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
  • Life, AD&D, Short and Long-Term Disability Insurance
  • Generous Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan with Company Match up to 3%
  • Daycare and Gym Reimbursement
  • Paid Parental Leave and New Mother Benefits
  • Training and Development Opportunities
  • Salary Range: $150,000–$165,000 per year

Availability of these benefits may depend on country and employment type.

title: Outpatient Clinical Therapist
description:
Promises Behavioral Health is seeking a Full-Time IOP Clinical Therapist!

Schedules available are Monday- Thursday 12pm-8pm or Monday- Thursday 12pm-8pm Friday 8am-4pm

Pay: $52,000/year- $77,000/year

About Our Organization

This position supports one of the trusted behavioral health programs within the Advanced Recovery Systems family. Advanced Recovery Systems is the parent organization of Promises Behavioral Health, The Right Step, and The Ranch, bringing together established treatment brands with a shared commitment to expanding access to high-quality, evidence-based addiction and mental health care.

While you may work primarily with a specific facility or brand, you will be part of a larger, growing organization focused on improving patient outcomes, supporting our employees and strengthening the communities we serve.

At the Washburn House addiction treatment center in Worcester, Massachusetts, we strive to provide a higher level of care. Our vision includes constantly enhancing and perfecting our techniques to provide our clients with the best therapeutic options possible. Through a close knit community of staff, residents, and family, we can build a brand new life for our clients.

Job Summary

Responsible for providing individual client and group therapy. This individual will provide services as a member of the inter-disciplinary treatment team, coordinating with the Director of Clinical Services, and other team members.

Essential Duties/Responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Conducts an initial assessment and establishes treatment goals for identified clients
  • Provides individual psychotherapy three 3 times each week to an assigned caseload of clients
  • Works collaboratively with the interdisciplinary team to ensure team treatment and a therapeutic milieu
  • Establishes therapeutic relationships with assigned clients to facilitate the treatment process
  • Provides effective communication during the shift through activity such as:
    1. Participates in report and utilizes information to provide quality care;
    2. Communicates milieu and client issues to the treatment team members during the shift and problem solves effectively;
    3. Ensures compliance with confidentiality of client information.
  • Takes lead as chief author, with the medical and nursing staffs, in writing the treatment plan of for the implementation of care according to client program policies and procedures
  • Completes all required documentation according to policies and procedures and ensures that daily clinical notes document the client's progress in meeting their treatment goals
  • Supports the nursing staff and recovery specialists identifying the precursors of potential crisis and unsafe client behavior, and intervenes to de-escalate clients utilizing the least restrictive means of intervention
  • Provides psycho-education groups to support the milieu treatment program
  • Participates in community outreach and marketing activities as required for Washburn House and promotes exceptional customer service throughout the program
  • Ensures active client and family participation in the treatment process
  • Reviews client and staff satisfaction surveys and customer complaints and the results of monitoring standards. Initiates corrective action as indicated and monitors identified quality improvements
  • Attends and participates in regularly scheduled staff meetings
  • Takes an active role in quality improvement activities as assigned

Requirements

  • Master's or Ph.D. in counseling, social work, psychology or other counseling-related field required.
  • LPC, LCSW or LMFT and clinical qualifications or intern status licensure required.
  • Three (3) years' experience in social work or related field.
  • Experience working with addictions and/or mental health.
  • Experience using a variety of interventions including DBT, CBT, Family Systems,
  • Ability to demonstrate understanding of a variety of models and theories of addiction, mental illness and related issues.
  • Knowledge of philosophies, practices, policies and outcomes of models of treatment, recovery, relapse prevention and continuing care for dually diagnosed populations.
  • Understanding of diagnostic criteria for dual conditions and the ability to conceptualize modalities and placement criteria within the continuum of care.
  • Ability to demonstrate an understanding of diverse cultures and gender-specific issues and ability to incorporate needs of gender and culturally diverse groups into practice setting.
  • Excellent organizational skills, including the ability to prioritize workload and work independently.
  • Proficient computer skills.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Expressive or training in Therapies preferred.
  • CPR/First Aid Certification is required for this position. If not CPR/First Aid certified at time of hire, certification must be obtained within the state mandated time frame after first day of employment.

Benefits

Enjoy a range of benefits, including a 401(k) plan, paid time off, comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, and so much more!

description:

The ideal candidate will bridge the gap between engineering design and construction documentation, ensuring that Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing systems are modeled accurately, fully coordinated, and clash-free.

Drafting, Modeling & Technical Delivery:

  • Lead the production of fully coordinated MEP drawings and BIM models for HVAC, Electrical (Power/Lighting/Low Current), Plumbing, Drainage, and Fire Fighting systems.
  • Prepare detailed schematics, riser diagrams, plant room layouts, and typical installation details for high-rise and industrial projects.
  • Ensure all MEP services are modeled to the required Level of Detail (LOD) and adhere to company CAD/BIM standards.
  • Convert engineering design mark-ups into accurate construction documentation and shop drawings.
  • Maintain updated libraries of MEP families and blocks to ensure modeling efficiency and accuracy.

Coordination & Clash Detection:

  • Utilize Navisworks to execute rigorous clash detection between MEP services and Structural/Architectural elements; manage the resolution of clashes with the engineering team.

  • Collaborate with the structural and civil teams to ensure penetrations, sleeves, and openings are accurately located in the structural model.

Site Support & Quality Control:

  • Review contractor shop drawings and material submittals against the design model to ensure compliance.
  • Assist in the production of Combined Services Drawings (CSD) and Builders Work in Connection (BWIC) drawings.
  • Conduct site inspections to verify that MEP installations match the coordinated BIM models and "As-Built" documentation whenever requested.

Requirements

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical/Electrical Engineering or a Diploma from a specialized technical institute is required.

title: Storekeeper
description:
A storekeeper oversees the warehouse operations, ensuring effective inventory control, transparency, and loss prevention. The role involves managing storage, maintaining accurate records, and issuing construction materials on site while ensuring proper handling, availability, and accountability of all items.

1. Receiving Materials

  • Receive materials delivered to the site.
  • Check documents (Purchase Order and Delivery Note).
  • Verify quantity and basic quality.
  • Report any shortages or damages immediately.
  • Record all received materials in the system (Excel or logbook).
  • Store materials properly in designated areas.

2. Issuing Materials

  • Issue materials only with an approved Material Requisition (MR).
  • Check and prepare requested items.
  • Ensure correct quantities are issued.
  • Record all issued materials.
  • Get a signature from the person receiving materials.

3. Stock Control

  • Maintain accurate stock records.
  • Update records daily.
  • Monitor stock levels and avoid shortages.
  • Keep storage areas clean and organised.

4. Reordering Support

  • Monitor fast-moving and critical materials.
  • Inform supervisor when stock is low.
  • Assist in preparing purchase requests.

5. Safety and Security

  • Ensure materials are stored safely.
  • Prevent damage, loss, or theft.
  • Control access to storage areas.
  • Follow site safety rules.

Requirements

  • Diploma or certificate in Procurement, Supply Chain, Business Administration, or related field.
  • 2–3 years of experience in stores or inventory management, preferably in construction.
  • Knowledge of inventory systems and ERP software is an advantage.
  • Basic knowledge of stock control principles and warehousing practices.

title: Test Engineer/QA Lead
description:
TechFlow is seeking an experienced Test Engineer / QA Lead to support a mission-critical DoD software development and modernization program in Montgomery, AL. This program provides software development and technical support services to sustain, enhance, and optimize a critical customer system through secure, scalable, and maintainable software solutions.

The Test Engineer / QA Lead will lead all quality assurance and software testing activities throughout the software development lifecycle. This role is responsible for developing and executing comprehensive manual and automated testing strategies, managing the software defect lifecycle, supporting cybersecurity accreditation activities, and ensuring software releases meet the highest standards for functionality, security, performance, accessibility, and reliability. Working closely with software engineers, architects, DevSecOps engineers, database administrators, and Government stakeholders, the QA Lead will help ensure every release is thoroughly validated before deployment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the planning, coordination, and execution of comprehensive software testing activities, including functional, regression, integration, security, performance, and user acceptance testing.
  • Design, develop, maintain, and execute automated test suites supporting web applications, APIs, databases, and system integrations.
  • Create and maintain detailed manual test cases and test procedures for scenarios that require manual validation.
  • Develop reusable automated testing frameworks to improve testing efficiency and release quality.
  • Manage the complete software defect lifecycle, including defect identification, documentation, prioritization, verification, and closure in collaboration with development teams.
  • Provide regular testing status updates, metrics, and quality reports to the Government Test Manager and program leadership.
  • Support Risk Management Framework (RMF) activities by producing required testing evidence, security validation documentation, and accreditation artifacts.
  • Validate software compliance with Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG), ensuring zero accessibility defects through automated and manual testing.
  • Verify software security scan results and ensure new vulnerabilities are remediated or properly documented, including validation of false positives.
  • Collaborate with Agile development teams to define test strategies, acceptance criteria, and quality objectives for each sprint.
  • Participate in peer reviews, sprint planning, release planning, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Promote quality engineering best practices, test automation, and continuous testing throughout the software development lifecycle.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree (or equivalent experience) in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in software quality assurance or test engineering within DoD, federal, or large enterprise environments.
  • Experience leading both manual and automated software testing efforts.
  • Proficiency with automated testing frameworks such as Selenium, JUnit, REST Assured, or equivalent testing tools.
  • Experience with API testing, database testing, and test automation development.
  • Experience managing software defect tracking and collaborating with development teams to resolve issues.
  • Familiarity with DoD Risk Management Framework (RMF) testing evidence requirements and security assessment reporting.
  • Experience using accessibility testing tools and validating compliance with WCAG standards.
  • Strong understanding of Agile software development methodologies and software development lifecycle (SDLC) processes.
  • Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills.
  • Active Secret Security Clearance.

Preferred Qualifications

  • ISTQB Certified Tester or equivalent software testing certification.
  • Experience supporting U.S. Air Force or other Department of Defense software modernization programs.
  • Experience with performance testing tools such as JMeter, LoadRunner, or similar platforms.
  • Experience with CI/CD-integrated automated testing.
  • Familiarity with GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, or Azure DevOps pipelines.
  • Experience validating STIG compliance and security testing results.
  • Knowledge of DevSecOps practices and continuous quality engineering methodologies.

Benefits

Founded in 1995 at the start of the dot-com revolution, TechFlow helped large commercial clients such as DreamWorks, Toshiba, MGM, and others modernize their business systems. Today, with deep operational roots in the bi-coastal innovation hubs of California and Washington DC, TechFlow continues as a leader in applying innovative engineering, technology, integration solutions, and support services to the Federal Government’s most demanding mission and business challenges.

Our culture thrives on out-of-the-box thinking and the unique powerful entrepreneurial expressions of our employee-owners. As a 100% employee-owned company, we have a shared expectation of commitment, accountability, and responsibility driven by a culture that embraces innovation and new ideas. Our goal is not to do what has been done, but to do it better.

TechFlow has four principal lines of business: Platform Services, Digital Services, Base Operations and Energy and Mobility Solutions. Our company has a strong track record of successful contracts in both areas and encourages cross-collaboration.

TechFlow, Inc is 100% employee-owned. Come make a difference in a job that contributes to your future and helps us build an agile workplace!

  • 401k plan with Roth option.

title: Sr. CRA I
description:
Sr. CRA I

Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.

Our Clinical Solutions team members act with a drug development mindset, applying their years of experience and deep expertise to truly understand customer needs and represent those in the solutions we shape.

Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to deliver – for one another, our customers, and, most importantly, for those in need.

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:

Why Syneos Health
• We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
• We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
• We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

Job Responsibilities

- Performs site qualification, site initiation, interim monitoring, site management and close-out visits (performed on-site or remotely) ensuring regulatory, ICH-GCP and/or Good Pharmacoepidemiology Practice (GPP) and protocol compliance. Uses judgment and experience to evaluate overall performance of site and site staff and to provide recommendations regarding site-specific actions; immediately communicates/escalates serious issues to the project team and develops action plans. Maintains a working knowledge of ICH/GCP Guidelines or other applicable guidance, relevant regulations, and company SOPs/processes.

- Verifies the process of obtaining informed consent has been adequately performed and documented for each subject/patient as required/appropriate. Demonstrates diligence in protecting the confidentiality of each subject/patient. Assesses factors that might affect subject/patient’s safety and clinical data integrity at an investigator/physician site such as protocol deviation/violations and pharmacovigilance issues.

- Per the Clinical Monitoring/Site Management Plan (CMP/SMP):

- Assesses site processes

- Conducts Source Document Review of appropriate site source documents and medical records

- Verifies required clinical data entered in the case report form (CRF)is accurate and complete via review of site source documents and medical records

- Applies query resolution techniques remotely and on site, and provides guidance to site staff as necessary, driving query resolution to closure within agreed timelines

- Utilizes available hardware and software to support the effective conduct of the clinical study data review and capture

- Verifies site compliance with electronic data capture requirements

- May perform investigational product (IP) inventory, reconciliation and reviews storage and security. Verifies the IP has been dispensed and administered to subjects/patients according to the protocol. Verifies issues or risks associated with blinded or randomized information related to IP. Applies knowledge of GCP/local regulations and organizational procedures to ensure IP is appropriately (re)labelled, imported and released/returned.

- Routinely reviews the Investigator Site File (ISF) for accuracy, timeliness and completeness. Reconciles contents of the ISF with the Trial Master File (TMF). Ensures the investigator/physician site is aware of the requirement of archiving essential documents in accordance with local guidelines and regulations.

- Documents activities via confirmation letters, follow-up letters, trip reports, communication logs, and other required project documents as per SOPs and Clinical Monitoring Plan/Site Management Plan. Supports subject/patient recruitment, retention and awareness strategies. Enters data into tracking systems as required to track all observations, ongoing status and assigned action items to resolution.

- Understands project scope, budgets, and timelines for own and others’ activities in the clinical team; manages site-level activities / communication to ensure project objectives, deliverables and timelines are met. Must be able to quickly adapt to changing priorities to achieve goals / targets.

- May act as primary liaison with project site personnel, or in collaboration with Central Monitoring Associate. Ensures all assigned sites and project-specific site team members are trained and compliant with applicable requirements.

- Prepares for and attends Investigator Meetings and/or sponsor face to face meetings. Participates, and may, with supervision, lead, global clinical monitoring/project staff meetings (inclusive of Sponsor representation, as applicable) and attends clinical training sessions according to the project specific requirements.

- Provides guidance at the site and project level towards audit readiness standards and supports preparation for audit and required follow-up actions.

- May provide training or mentorship to more junior level CRAs. May perform training and sign off visits for junior CRA staff, as assigned.

- May be mentored and assigned clinical operations lead tasks under supervision of an experienced Clinical Operations Lead (COL), or operational line manager.

- For Real World Late Phase (RWLP), the Sr. CRA I will use the businesscard title of Sr. Site Management Associate I. Additional responsibilities include:

- Site support throughout the study lifecycle from site identification through close out

- Knowledge of local requirements for real world late phase study designs

- Chart abstraction activities and data collection

- As required, collaborate and build relationships with Sponsor and other affiliates, medical science liaisons and local country staff

- Identify and communicate out of scope activities to Lead CRA/Project Manager

- Proactively suggest potential sites based on local knowledge of treatment patterns, patient advocacy and Health Care Provider (HCP) associations

- Identify operational efficiencies and process improvements

- Develop country level informed consent forms

- Collaborate with RWLP Regulatory team to ensure updated regulatory information is applied and shared

- Participate in bid defense meetings

Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree or RN in a related field or equivalent combination of education, training and experience

- Knowledge of Good Clinical Practice/ICH Guidelines and other applicable regulatory requirements

- Must demonstrate good computer skills and be able to embrace new technologies

- Excellent communication, presentation and interpersonal skills. Basic level of critical thinking skills expected.

- Ability to manage required travel of up to 75% on a regular basis

Get to know Syneos Health


Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

title: EF Manufacturing Cost & Coverage Controller / Improvement Lead
description:

Do you want to be part of progress? And do you want to work in a dynamic international environment? In the ASML Finance department we are responsible for all financial, economic and fiscal affairs.   • Team player, enjoys working in multidisciplinary and multicultural teams with the ability to work independently;
  • Own quality and be guided by awareness of customer impact.
  • Hands-on mentality / getting things done.

The position reports to the BI&C Global Manufacturing lead who creates the conditions that enable you to realize your full potential.
