title: Control & Protection Application Engineer
description:
Job Description Summary

GE Vernova Grid Solutions is seeking a Control & Protection Application Engineer to support the design, development, modelling, verification, and application of HVDC Control and Protection systems for LCC and VSC HVDC schemes.
The role spans tendering, project execution, contractual support, after-sales activities, and future NPI-driven developments, with a strong focus on model-based design using MATLAB/Simulink as the reference engineering environment.
The engineer will work within a multi-disciplinary team and contribute across the full delivery lifecycle, from requirement definition and functional design through simulation, verification, and continuous improvement.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

Control & Protection Design and Requirements

• Analyze customer technical specifications and define HVDC control and protection system requirements, including identification of deviations from standard solutions.

• Prepare control, protection, and sequencing strategy specifications, including start-up, shutdown, and fault recovery sequences.

• Define requirements and ensure adherence to engineering best practices, internal standards, and standard product methodologies.

• Design, develop, model, and debug HVDC control and protection algorithms using MATLAB/Simulink, including control algorithms, protection logic and interlocks, supervisory control and state machines & sequencing functions

• Perform algorithm and state-machine development in MATLAB/Simulink as the master design reference.

• Develop verification models in MATLAB and create test harnesses to support model validation and conversion activities.

• Maintain model documentation and model guides to support reuse and standardization.

• Perform plant modeling of HVDC systems using MATLAB, PSCAD, RSCAD, EMTP-type tools, and verify consistency across platforms.

• Execute HVDC system modeling in electromagnetic transient tools such as PSCAD, EMTP-RV, RSCAD, including network conversion (PSSE → PSCAD / RSCAD where applicable) along with model verification and validation

• Convert MATLAB/Simulink control algorithms into PSCAD / RSCAD / other time-domain library models.

• Perform Dynamic Performance Studies (DPS) using offline and online simulation tools.

• Tune control and protection parameters to meet grid stability and performance criteria specified in customer technical requirements.

• Analyze and resolve power fault recovery and instability issues identified during DPS or system studies.

• Execute assigned control design, protection design, and verification work packages on time and within defined budgets, under guidance from lead engineers.

• Follow departmental standard design practices, engineering reviews, and verification guidelines.

• Support model verification, functional testing, and validation activities across simulation environments.

• Support R&D and NPI teams in developing and improving existing and new control and protection products, tools, and strategies.

• Contribute to development of new control, protection, and sequencing strategies to meet evolving customer or grid requirements.

• Propose and implement continuous improvement initiatives to enhance team effectiveness and efficiency through improved tools, methods, and processes.

• Promote reuse of standard solutions to improve quality, reliability, and delivery timelines while reducing cost.

• Support Tendering, Operations, Contractual, and After-Sales activities related to HVDC control and protection systems & collaborate across multiple teams

• Participate in cross-functional training and knowledge sharing to strengthen overall engineering capability.

• Communicate effectively with internal stakeholders and customers; prepare technical reports and respond to technical queries.

Required Qualifications and Skills

• Engineering degree (Bachelor’s or Master’s) in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems, Power Electronics, or Control Engineering.

•Experience in HVDC Control, Protection, and Sequencing strategy development

• Knowledge of power system stability and performance analysis.

• Experience with PSS®E, PowerFactory, ETAP or similar tools.

• Exposure to real-time or HIL simulation platforms (RTDS, OPAL-RT).

• Experience in process improvement, RCA, or standardization initiatives.

• Strong experience in MATLAB/Simulink-based model development for control and protection systems.

• Solid understanding of HVDC systems, including control, protection, sequencing, and AC–DC system interactions.

• Experience with PSCAD, RSCAD, EMTP-type tools for HVDC system and plant modeling.

• Ability to identify and manage technical risks and work under schedule pressure while maintaining engineering integrity.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to engage in customer technical discussions.

• Willingness to support global projects, including flexible working hours and travel.

Additional Information

Relocation Assistance Provided: Yes

1. Employee Relations & Workforce Management

2. Labour Law Compliance & HR Governance

  • Maintain accurate and secure HR records such as contracts, disciplinary files, leave records, onboarding documentation, and statutory filings while ensuring confidentiality of employee and client-sensitive information.

3. Recruitment, Onboarding & Workforce Planning

  • Manage onboarding processes, including orientation, integration programs, and initiatives that improve retention and operational readiness.
  • Oversee pre-employment and onboarding compliance activities such as background checks, verification, and documentation.

4. Performance Management & Operational HR Support

  • Support implementation and administration of performance management frameworks to ensure consistent application across operations.

5. Policy Development & Process Improvement

  • Lead the implementation and enforcement of operational HR governance frameworks including escalation matrices, code of conduct standards, zero-tolerance policies, attendance governance, and workplace behavior protocols.
  • Partner with Operations and Security teams to ensure consistent application of client-specific workplace compliance standards and disciplinary controls.
  • Review, update, and implement HR policies, SOPs, and employee handbook provisions to ensure alignment with operational needs and legal requirements.
  • Develop scalable HR processes suitable for a startup environment while ensuring practicality and enforceability.
  • Ensure HR policies comply with local legislation and meet international client expectations, including workplace standards.
  • Drive continuous improvement in HR operations and employee experience, including alignment with PCI compliance and client contractual obligations.

6. Stakeholder Management & Business Partnership

  • Serve as a trusted HR advisor to managers and leadership, supporting decision-making and people strategy discussions.
  • Facilitate communication and alignment between local operations and international stakeholders to ensure consistency in execution.

In addition, the Material Engineer will align material delivery with project schedules and drive value engineering by recommending sustainable, cost‑effective alternatives without compromising design intent.

Key Duties and Responsibilities

Material Specification & Procurement:

  • Review, analyze, and approve high-end material specifications, technical datasheets, and test reports to ensure full compliance with project design requirements and structural/architectural standards.
  • Leverage extensive knowledge of construction material markets in the Middle East, China, India, North Africa, and East Africa to identify optimal suppliers and premium manufacturers.

Catalogue, Sample Management & Presentation:

  • Lead the preparation, curation, and presentation of comprehensive material catalogues, mood boards, and physical sample boards for consultant review and executive management approval.
  • Prepare and deliver clear, convincing technical and commercial presentations to senior management, consultants, and stakeholders to facilitate swift material selection.

Quality Assurance & Lifecycle Assessment:

  • Oversee material testing protocols, ensure that all materials delivered to the site match the approved samples exactly, and assess long-term durability for luxury finishes.
  • Track production lead times and shipping logistics to ensure material delivery seamlessly aligns with the master construction schedule.
  • Proactively drive value engineering by identifying alternative premium materials that optimize project costs and sustainability without compromising the architectural design intent.

Requirements

Skills and experience:

title: Commercial Loan Processor - To 72K - Dallas, TX - Job 3560FR
description:
Commercial Loan Processor – To $72K – Dallas, TX – Job # 3560FR

Who We Are

The Symicor Group is a boutique talent acquisition firm based in Schaumburg, IL & Rockport, TX. Our nationally unique value proposition centers around providing the very best available banking and accounting talent. In fact, most of our recruiters are former bankers or accountants themselves!

We know how to evaluate the very best banking and accounting talent available in the market. Whether you are a candidate seeking a new opportunity or a bank or company president trying to fill an essential position, The Symicor Group stands ready to deliver premium results for you.

The Position

Our bank client is seeking to fill a Commercial Loan Processor role located in the Dallas, TX area. The position is responsible for the preparation, accuracy, and completeness of commercial loan packages, using the Bank’s documentation system and procedures. The candidate will be processing and preparing commercial loan products, as assigned.

The opportunity has a generous salary of up to $72K and a full benefits package. (This is not a remote position.)

Commercial Loan Processor responsibilities include:

  • Processing commercial loan requests for both new and renewal loans using prescribed procedures and software.
  • Making an initial review of the loan approval (Profile), using information available on the loan processing software system and credit file, obtaining required information for underwriting, and preparing loan closing documents.
  • Preparing all necessary loan documents including Promissory Note, Business Loan Agreement, Construction Loan Agreement, Disbursement Request and Authorization, Resolutions, and Loan Checklist using information from the loan application, profile, and title policy.
  • Confirming loan approval authority as defined by bank policy; review and obtain an understanding of the loan transaction from the Loan Profile.
  • Determining that initial underwriting documentation is present according to the approval document.
  • Reviewing credit files and determining additional documentation needs to support underwriting requirements, such as entity papers, credit reports, purchase contracts, lien searches, title work, appraisal or evaluation, environmental questionnaire, survey, life insurance, and property liability insurance.
  • Ordering supporting documentation from approved vendors and working with loan officers or customers as needed.
  • Renewal loan processing includes entering the loan into loan software and working with the servicing loan officer to move the approved credit to close.
  • Communicating results of documentation review and any processing issues to the loan officer on a timely basis.
  • Balancing transactions and preparing all general ledger tickets and cashier’s checks for disbursement.
  • Preparing wire forms, wire tickets, and authorizing wires for loan proceeds.
  • Processing loan file post-closing, including preparation and delivery of instruction letter and the closing packet to the title company if needed.
  • Assisting with additional loan operation roles, as requested or necessary.

Who Are You?

You’re someone who wants to influence your own development. You’re looking for an opportunity where you can pursue your interests and your passion. Where a job title is not considered the final definition of who you are, but merely the starting point for your future.

You also bring the following skills and experience:

  • High School Diploma or equivalent required; two (2) year degree or higher preferred.
  • Two or more years of experience in commercial loan document preparation and/or document processing.
  • Understanding of the required documentation for commercial term loans and lines of credit and the associated collateral documentation.
  • Ability to prioritize work on complex loan transactions to meet scheduled loan closing dates.
  • Knowledge of compliance requirements for commercial borrowers.
  • Knowledge of related state and federal lending and compliance laws and regulations, and other Bank lending policies.
  • Highly accurate data entry skills and a strong level of skill working with a variety of PC and internet applications, including LaserPro, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint, and the ability to navigate key industry-specific Internet sites.
  • Strong multi-tasking, time management, thoroughness, and accuracy skills required.
  • Solid communication and organizational skills with a focus on teamwork and cooperation.
  • A high level of confidentiality is required.
  • Ability to work under deadlines with frequent interruption.

resumes@symicorgroup.com

title: Research Engineer
description:
Location: San Francisco, CA

Work Model: On-site

Industry: AI training data infrastructure

Compensation: $140K-$250K base, plus equity

About the Company

Our partner is a YC-backed company building a new kind of marketplace in the AI training data space. Rather than operating as a labor marketplace, they provide infrastructure that lets data producers transform their existing data into formats AI labs want and sell it directly to those labs. This democratized model unlocks far more high-value data sources, and the team is growing quickly to keep up with demand.

The Opportunity

This is the company's top hiring priority and a genuinely hard research problem. Because data flows through a decentralized marketplace, ensuring quality at scale is the single biggest bottleneck to growth. As a Research Engineer, you will build the automated systems that verify and assure data quality so that suppliers consistently deliver excellent data to buyers.

You will start by digging into the data manually to understand failure modes, then design systems to automate quality checks at scale, combining rule-based approaches with AI for fuzzier cases and human-in-the-loop review where it makes sense. This is fundamentally a research role focused on building automated systems, not manual QA.

Responsibilities

  • Identify data quality issues including inconsistencies, formatting problems, and ingestion challenges
  • Perform initial manual data quality review to deeply understand failure modes
  • Build systems to automate quality checks at scale using rule-based and AI-driven approaches
  • Design hybrid systems that balance automation with human-in-the-loop review where appropriate
  • Continuously improve verification methods as the data landscape and AI tooling evolve

Requirements

  • Deeply technical, with a strong learning slope and the ability to ramp quickly in a fast-moving field
  • Background in AI/ML engineering, or software engineering at an AI-focused company with visible data ingestion and processing experience
  • Ability to reason about likely data quality problems from first principles
  • Comfortable owning ambiguous, open-ended problems end to end
  • Comfortable working in person, full-time, in a San Francisco office
  • Bonus: experience working with noisy or unstructured data, or judgment on when to use automation versus human-in-the-loop review

description:
Bank Controller – To $175K – Chicago, IL – Job # 3527

Who We Are

The Symicor Group is a boutique talent acquisition firm based in Schaumburg, IL & Rockport, TX. Our nationally unique value proposition centers around providing the very best available banking and accounting talent. In fact, most of our recruiters are former bankers or accountants themselves!

You’re someone who wants to influence your own development. You’re looking for an opportunity where you can pursue your interests and your passion. Where a job title is not considered the final definition of who you are, but merely the starting point for your future.

You also bring the following skills and experience:

  • Minimum ten (10) years of experience in accounting for financial institution with experience in staff supervision.
  • Intimate knowledgeable of GAAP and current reporting requirements for financial institutions.

resumes@symicorgroup.com

title: RL Environment Software Engineer
description:
Location: San Francisco, CA

Work Model: Onsite

Industry: Applied AI / AI research data

Compensation: $180K-$220K base, ~$400K+ OTE (uncapped profit share)

About the Company

Our partner is a fast-growing applied AI research lab that builds high-quality reinforcement-learning environments and agents sold to the world's leading AI labs. In under two years they have scaled to a nine-figure revenue run rate and grown their team severalfold in a matter of months, backed by leading venture investors. Quality is their core differentiator, and they are rapidly expanding into new domains.

The Opportunity

As an RL Environment Software Engineer, you will sit at the intersection of research engineering and traditional software engineering, building the environments that simulate real-world workflows and the agents that automate them. This is forward-looking work, you will help research and predict what high-quality environments the frontier will need next, then build them from the ground up.

You will join a brand-new RL team being assembled with exceptional talent, with a clear path to grow alongside it as the function scales into industry pods.

Responsibilities

  • Design and build high-quality RL environments that simulate real working environments end to end.
  • Develop agents for the tasks within those environments and iterate until they are efficient and production-ready.
  • Partner with the research team to scope which environments to build and why, staying ahead of future demand rather than only meeting present needs.
  • Own the backend and infrastructure layers that make environments reliable and scalable.
  • Help set engineering standards for a zero-to-one team as the RL function grows.

Requirements

  • Strong machine-learning engineers who code heavily and build systems from scratch, with strong intuition for reinforcement learning.
  • Proficiency across a modern stack, Node.js and Python on the backend and React/TypeScript on the frontend, with strong Kubernetes and Docker skills.
  • Comfort operating in a fast-paced startup environment with high ownership and long hours.
  • A track record of meaningful tenure and impact at previous companies.
  • Reinforcement-learning experience or an RL research background is a strong plus, though not required.
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

title: Senior Assistant Vice President
description:

Transformation Strategy & Operating Model Design

Data-Driven Insights & Analytics

  • Oversee advanced analytics, visualization, and AI-driven insights to inform program priorities and executive decision-making

Stakeholder Engagement, Governance & Change Management

  • Own senior client relationships - acting as trusted transformation advisor to client CXOs and COOs
  • Establish robust program governance - steering committees, RAID management, and executive reporting
  • Drive change management and adoption strategies to ensure transformation outcomes are sustained
  • Develop and monitor transformation KPIs and benefits realization dashboards

Team Leadership & Practice Building

  • Lead, coach, and develop the transformation team including the AVP and project leads
  • Build the Digital Ops Transformation practice - methodologies, assets, case studies, and capabilities that differentiate EXL in the market
  • Partner with talent and HR to attract, develop, and retain high-caliber transformation professionals

Thought Leadership & Innovation

  • Stay ahead of industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices across target domains
  • Represent EXL in client forums, industry events, and internal leadership sessions as a transformation subject matter expert
  • Contribute to EXL's AI-first operating model philosophy and innovation agenda

Education

Experience

description:
About Us

This is a full or part-time, on-site role as a School Psychologist serving a school located in Lafayette, IN.

The School Psychologist will be responsible for providing therapy services to students, conducting assessments, developing IEP plans, evaluating and eligibility processes, collaborating with interdisciplinary teams (therapists, educators, parents), supporting students according to their IEP. The role requires strong communication and interpersonal skills, as well as a passion for working with students with special needs.

Position Details

  • Maintain accurate documentation, prepare written reports, and participate in IEP meetings and other collaborative student support activities
  • Guaranteed paid hours include direct services, documentation, planning, meetings, and administrative responsibilities
  • Manageable caseloads that promote quality services and positive student outcomes
  • Ongoing collaboration and professional support from both the partnering school district and the TheraPeds Partners team
  • $65–$85+ per hour, with estimated weekly earnings of approximately $1,625–$2,125+ based on a 25-hour work week

Requirements

Qualifications

  • Experience working with children and adolescents
  • Organizational and time management skills
  • Proficient in use of technology
  • Fingerprint background clearance

Physical Requirements

Working and playing with students requires that employees must be able to perform the necessary physical movement functions, as needed, such as lifting, sitting, walking, standing, crawling, and engaging with students in all physical locations and activities, while adhering to the duties outlined by the district.

  • Access to a supportive network within the TheraPeds community
  • Guaranteed hours
  • Bi-monthly salary deposits
  • This position will be a W-2 employee or a 1099 contractor

TheraPeds Partners is seeking a part-time or full-time on-site School Psychologist for a school-based position in Lafayette, IN. This role is ideal for candidates searching for school psychology jobs near me or Indiana school psychologist positions

description:
Location: Remote (United States)

Work Model: Remote

Industry: B2B SaaS / AI-powered data and automation software

Compensation: $210K base, ~$250K-$260K total compensation including equity

About the Company

Our partner is an early-stage, venture-backed B2B software startup building AI-powered products that move and transform data and automate complex workflows. The company recently closed its Series A (roughly $15M raised to date) and grew revenue nearly 4x in the first half of the year. As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you will work across the stack, spanning frontend, backend, and the data pipelines and agentic/AI workflows at the core of the product. The stack is modern and intentionally lean (TypeScript and React, some Python, Postgres, Temporal for durable workflows, a monorepo with no microservices), so you can move quickly on genuinely hard problems.

You will join a small, senior engineering team during a period of rapid growth, with meaningful equity and a direct line to the founders. Occasional customer conversations come with the early stage, but the role is primarily focused on building.

  • Build and ship features across the full stack, with an emphasis on backend systems
  • Design and maintain data pipelines and data-movement workflows
  • Contribute to agentic and AI-driven product capabilities
  • Take customer feedback and help shape product direction, not just execute tickets
  • Collaborate closely with a small, senior team in a fast-moving codebase

Requirements

  • 5-7 years of full stack engineering experience (4+ considered on the lower end)
  • Strong proficiency in TypeScript and React, with some Python
  • Product-minded engineer who can form opinions and contribute to product direction

  • Startup experience preferred; candidates from later-stage startups are welcome if they can articulate why they want an early-stage environment
  • Able to work onsite in New York City five days per week
  • Bonus: experience with ETL / data movement, browser automation or scraping, AWS, or agentic infrastructure

title: Senior Product Manager, Cloud Operations & Infrastructure (COI)
description:
AVEVA is creating software trusted by over 90% of leading industrial companies.

Job Title: Senior Product Manager, Cloud Operations & Infrastructure (COI)

Location: Cambridge, United Kingdom (Hybrid)

Employment Type: full-time

The job

The successful candidate will work in the CONNECT Portfolio team reporting to the Director of Portfolio, CONNECT Common Services. The role is responsible for product management across AVEVA’s Cloud Operations and Infrastructure (COI) domain — the shared platform, cloud infrastructure, and operational practices that underpin every capability delivered on CONNECT.

As Product Manager for COI, you will champion cloud operational readiness across the organisation, helping evolve AVEVA’s SaaS operational effectiveness. You will act as the connective tissue between the teams that build and operate the platform — R&D, Delivery, Commercial Operations, and Support — and the capability teams that depend on it, reducing friction, accelerating delivery, and making cloud readiness a natural, built-in part of how capabilities are designed and delivered.

The role spans three connected areas: the developer platform and enablement tooling that teams build, test, and deploy with; the organisation-wide cloud-readiness that raises confidence and value across the portfolio; and the underlying cloud infrastructure and cloud estate foundations that CONNECT services run on. You will discover, distil, prioritise, and translate requirements from across these areas into a clear, measurable roadmap, and create organisational transparency into COI’s delivery.

Key responsibilities

  • Product Management for Cloud Operations & Infrastructure: Lead product management for the COI domain, spanning the developer platform and shared development infrastructure, cloud-readiness practices, and the foundational cloud infrastructure and estate that powers CONNECT services.
  • Champion Cloud Readiness Across the Organisation: Drive timely adoption of cloud-operational readiness practices within capability definition and planning, working alongside Portfolio and R&D. Ensure teams prioritise cloud operational readiness as a standard part of the development process, unblocking misunderstandings, and socialising the benefits with stakeholders across the portfolio.
  • Engage Stakeholders & Gather Requirements: Partner with Value Realization (VR) owners, Development and Delivery teams, and leadership to understand short- and long-term needs. Incorporate customer feedback and market signals to keep COI’s direction grounded in real demand.
  • Translate Requirements into Measurable Deliverables: Turn requirements from the field and stakeholders into actionable, scoped, and measurable deliverables with clear success criteria, captured and maintained in tools such as Aha! and Azure DevOps.
  • Reduce Friction & Accelerate Delivery: Guide and assist teams in supporting operational and shared platform needs, reducing friction in deployment pipelines and accelerating release cycles. Enable the tools and learning resources that shorten onboarding time for developers and teams aligning to cloud-readiness expectations.
  • Own & Evolve Shared Development Infrastructure: Maintain and enhance the foundational infrastructure that development teams across services rely on to build, test, and deploy efficiently, ensuring it scales with demand.
  • Ensure Capabilities are Observable: Working across the organisation to ensure that capabilities are observable and with defined service level metrics.
  • Establish & Scale CONNECT Infrastructure Foundations: Identify and enable delivery of new infrastructure components and practices that support Value Realization initiatives across the CONNECT domains, providing robust, scalable foundations for platform stability and performance.
  • Drive Standards & Fitness for Purpose: Validate that COI deliverables are fit for purpose, and that service descriptions and definitions are standard, accurate, and consistent across the platform.
  • Facilitate SaaS Operational Readiness: Host a regular SaaS Operational Readiness forum spanning COI, R&D, Commercial Operations, and Support to align priorities, track progress, and maintain transparent communication of roadmaps and delivery plans, including regular backlog grooming of field requirements.

Measures of Success

  • Increased cloud-operational awareness, confidence, and value across the organisation, with COI established as a trusted point of coordination for AVEVA’s SaaS business.
  • Faster, more reliable cloud delivery across service domains through streamlined, consistent deployment practices.
  • Reduced time-to-adopt and improved time-to-market for new and existing capabilities achieving cloud readiness.
  • Scalable, stable CONNECT infrastructure foundations that capability teams can build on with confidence.

Essential requirements

Cloud, Platform & Technical Depth

  • Cloud & SaaS Expertise: Solid understanding of cloud architecture, SaaS delivery models, and what it takes to operate services reliably at scale.
  • Developer Platform & DevOps Awareness: Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, infrastructure-as-code concepts, and the practices that make development teams productive.
  • Operational Excellence Mindset: Understanding of cloud readiness, reliability, and the operational disciplines that underpin a mature SaaS platform.
  • Emerging Technology Awareness: Awareness of AI/ML operations and how they can improve efficiency across platform and delivery workflows.

Stakeholder Influence & Communication

  • Influence Without Authority: Proven ability to align and motivate teams across functions — R&D, Delivery, Portfolio, Commercial Operations, and Support — without direct reporting lines.
  • Executive Communication: Superior verbal, written, and presentation skills to engage stakeholders at all levels.
  • Facilitation & Negotiation: Strong ability to guide discussions, build consensus, and resolve competing priorities.
  • Storytelling & Persuasion: Ability to articulate the value of cloud readiness and platform investment to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Analytical & Prioritisation Skills

  • Data-Driven Decision Making: Ability to use metrics and analytics to prioritise investment and demonstrate impact.
  • Requirements Distillation: Ability to take ambiguous, multi-source input and turn it into clear, scoped, measurable deliverables.
  • Product Trade-Offs: Ability to balance short-term and long-term investment to optimise platform capabilities.

Planning & Operational Excellence

  • Roadmap & Backlog Management: Strong organisational skills with the ability to maintain roadmaps, groom backlogs, and communicate delivery plans transparently.
  • Project & Deadline Management: Ability to plan, prioritise, and meet deadlines across multiple concurrent initiatives.

Additional Requirements

  • Previous product management experience, ideally in platform, infrastructure, DevOps, or internal-enablement domains.
  • Ability to work effectively across diverse teams both functionally and geographically (primarily U.K., EMEA, and North America).
  • Flexibility to travel periodically, if needed.
  • Prior experience in Enterprise / SaaS / B2B industry preferred but not required.
  • Familiarity with tools like Aha!, Azure DevOps, and AVEVA back-office systems (SFDC, Zuora, Oracle, Gainsight) preferred but not required.

UK Benefits include:

Flexible benefits fund, emergency leave days, adoption leave, 28 days annual leave (plus bank holidays), pension, life cover, private medical insurance, parental leave, education assistance program.


It’s possible we’re hiring for this position in multiple countries, in which case the above benefits apply to the primary location. Specific benefits vary by country, but our packages are similarly comprehensive.


Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/benefits/


Hybrid working

We work in a hybrid way at AVEVA. Most roles are based at a local AVEVA office, with an expectation of being on-site 50% of your working hours to support collaboration and connection. Some positions are fully office-based depending on the nature of the work, and certain roles that support specific customers or markets may be remote. The working arrangement for this position will be confirmed during the hiring process.


Hiring process

Interested? Great! Get started by submitting your cover letter and CV through our application portal. AVEVA is committed to recruiting and retaining people with disabilities. Please let us know in advance if you need reasonable support during your application process.


Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/hiring-process

AVEVA is a global leader in industrial software with more than 6,500 employees in over 40 countries. Our cutting-edge solutions are used by thousands of enterprises to deliver the essentials of life – such as energy, infrastructure, chemicals, and minerals – safely, efficiently, and more sustainably.

title: ICT System Engineer
description:
Company Overview

As an ICT Systems Engineer, you will take the lead in developing and implementing automated workflows, system integrations, and process improvements that enhance operational efficiency, reduce manual interventions, and support scalable business growth.

A secondary but critical responsibility is strengthening the organization’s cybersecurity posture. You will implement and maintain security controls, monitor threats, and ensure compliance with security standards across all systems and networks.

In addition, you will support the design, implementation, and optimization of the organization’s ICT infrastructure. This role requires broad expertise across systems, software, hardware, and networks. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to drive digital transformation, enhance system performance, and ensure secure, resilient, and efficient technology environments that align with the organization’s strategic objectives.

Key Responsibilities

1. Automation Leadership

  • Build and deploy Microsoft Power Apps, Power Automate workflows, and SharePoint solutions.
  • Identify automation opportunities to reduce manual workloads and improve efficiency.
  • Champion adoption of low-code applications across departments.

2. Cybersecurity & Compliance

  • Monitor, detect, and neutralize cybersecurity threats using industry-standard tools.
  • Implement IAM, endpoint protection, and network security controls.
  • Conduct vulnerability assessments, patch management, and security audits.
  • Lead incident response and forensic investigations

3. System Design & Implementation

  • Deploy and maintain ICT systems with scalability, reliability, and security in mind.
  • Translate business requirements into effective technical solutions.

4. Server & Infrastructure Administration

  • Manage Windows Server environments, Active Directory, Group Policies, and Microsoft 365 services.
  • Perform updates, patches, and backups to ensure system reliability and performance.
  • Optimize network infrastructure including switches, routers, wireless access points, DNS, DHCP, and VPNs.

5. ICT Support & Service Excellence

  • Provide expert-level support for hardware, software, and enterprise applications.
  • Resolve escalated service desk tickets quickly and accurately.
  • Support onboarding/offboarding processes including device provisioning and secure access.
  • Maintain documentation, knowledge bases, and ICT procedures.
  • Collaborate with teams to embed innovative digital solutions into operations.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field.
  • Proven expertise with Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI (optional), and SharePoint.
  • Extensive programming experience using either Java, C#, Python, JavaScript
  • Working knowledge of DevSecOps tools such as Jira, Git, Jenkins or related tools and platforms.
  • 5–7 years of experience in ICT support, systems administration, or cybersecurity.
  • Strong knowledge of Windows Server, Active Directory, Azure AD, and Microsoft 365.
  • Practical cybersecurity experience (endpoint protection, IAM, MFA, SIEM tools, vulnerability management).
  • Certifications such as Microsoft Power Platform, Security+, AZ-900, SC-900, Cisco, MCSE, and CCNP are highly desirable.

title: Field Retention Agents
description:

The Structured Finance and Alternate Investment Funds practice evaluates the credit risk of securitized products and fund structures by analysing underlying asset performance, structural protections, cash-flow mechanics, and downside stress scenarios. Analysts produce opinions that help issuers and investors compare complex instruments, bringing market-relevant perspectives on topics such as performance trends, issuance conditions, and AI’s role in origination and securitization.

This role presents an opportunity to contribute to a team at the forefront of ratings innovation focused on structured finance. title: Resident Advisor in Monetary and Foreign Exchange Market Operations  (CCAMTAC) (MCMTA)
location: Caucasus, Central Asia, and Mongolia Regional Technical Assistance Center (CCAMTAC)
description:
Work for the IMF. Work for the World.

The Monetary and Capital Markets (MCM) Department of the International Monetary Fund (IMF) is recruiting a well-qualified and experienced expert to work as resident advisor in monetary and foreign exchange market operations at the IMF Caucasus, Central Asia, and Mongolia Regional Capacity Development Center (CCAMTAC) located in Almaty, Kazakhstan. This is a twelve‑month initial assignment with the possibility of extension typically up to three to five years based on performance and funding availability.

CCAMTAC is a multi-donor-financed Regional Capacity Development Center, providing capacity development (CD)—technical assistance (TA) and training—to nine member countries to strengthen their institutional capacity to design and implement sound macroeconomic and financial policies. The CCAMTAC member countries include Armenia, Azerbaijan, Georgia, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyz Republic, Mongolia, Tajikistan, Turkmenistan, and Uzbekistan.

The resident advisor assists participating countries in modernizing their monetary policy frameworks and operations. Additionally, with the assistance of MCM and short-term experts, the resident advisor may be asked to provide support on other central bank operations. The advisor will be part of the CCAMTAC team () and backstopped by the MCM Department of the IMF.

Duties and responsibilities

The resident advisor responds to CCAMTAC member countries’ CD and cooperation requests and is expected to travel or provide remote assistance to these countries to perform the assigned duties.

The advisor is also expected to lead/organize selected training for the member countries in Almaty or in other locations. By elaborating well-prioritized medium-term work programs, s/he assists CCAMTAC members through:

· Delivering TA on governance, accounting, and central bank financial reporting, central bank communication and transparency, monetary policy implementation and domestic market operations, FX policy implementation, FX reserve management, and FX market development, and central bank liquidity backstops for financial stability, directly and through short-term experts backstopped by the resident advisor.

· Assessing monetary policy frameworks and advising on central bank operations in line with monetary policy regimes and the central bank mandates.

· Developing specific recommendations on the necessary legislative, regulatory, and operational steps to improve monetary and foreign exchange market operations.

· Preparing required documents prior to and after each mission for MCM internal review and approval and ensure transmission of final documents to the relevant country authorities.

· Coordinating with MCM regarding member countries’ central bank operations TA requests .

· Conducting, facilitating, or otherwise participating in country or regional workshops and seminars/ webinars on monetary and foreign exchange market operations, including collaborating with other resident advisors in CCAMTAC.

· Coordinating with MCM, including backstoppers, on policy areas and keeping them up to date on major developments, to ensure that any advice provided by the advisor is consistent with IMF policies.

· Observing IMF policies and procedures, applying the results-based management (RBM) strategic framework in guiding CD activities.[1]

· Leading annual work planning and budgeting for the CD program in CCAMTAC on monetary and foreign exchange market operations and contributing to the Center’s reporting and outreach activities.

Qualifications

The successful candidate should demonstrate creativity and initiative and have:

· At least five years of experience working in a central bank, in-depth understanding of international standards and good practices for monetary and foreign exchange market operations and experience of their implementation at national and/or international level.

· Expertise in TA delivery in central bank operations is an advantage.

· A graduate degree in economics, finance, accounting, or a related area.

· Excellent interpersonal skills, including the ability to work effectively with senior policymakers in the region and the donor community, to lead teams of senior experts, to work as part of a team that would include staff at IMF headquarters as well as in CCAMTAC, and to handle sensitive and confidential issues with discretion in a multicultural environment.

· Strong verbal and written communication skills in English, including presentational skills in support of training-related activities.

· Good organizational and time management skills in balancing demands from member countries with duties and responsibilities from MCM and CCAMTAC.

· Proficiency in modern computer systems and applications, including AI.

The successful candidate will be selected based on a written test and a panel interview. Compensation and benefits are competitive and commensurate with qualifications and experience.

[1] The RBM framework focuses on performance and achievement results, supported by the Fund’s Capacity Development Management and Administration Program (CDMAP).

Department:

MCMTA Monetary and Capital Markets Dept. Technical Assistance Strategy

A11, A12, A13, A14

description:
